body:
08/09/2013 7:00 PM
Regarding the Price Change of the Square Enix Security Token (Aug. 9)
We would like to take this opportunity to announce the price increase of the Square Enix Security Token as of Sep. 1, 2013.

Up until this point, we focused heavily on keeping the cost down despite increased production costs and the cost of implementing counter measures against security breaches. However, we came to a conclusion that it is no longer possible to maintain the existing price of the Square Enix Token.

Therefore, in order for us to sustain the security level that we have been offering, we will need to slightly increase the price of the Square Enix Security Token.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your understanding.

Please note that we also offer the Square Enix Software Token app for iOS and Android free of charge.

* Please visit the following URL for more information on the Square Enix Security Token and the Square Enix Software Token app.
http://www.square-enix.com/na/account/otp/

Details on the Price Change:
Before: $9.99 / 999 Crysta
After: $10.99 / 1,099 Crysta

Date:
Any orders placed after Sep. 1, 2013

*On Aug. 29, 2013 around 1:00 a.m., we have revised the prices due to the incorrect Crysta prices that were displayed incorrectly.

Regarding an Issue with a Recent Windows Update (Aug. 14)
We have confirmed an issue with a recent Windows update that took place on Jul. 11, 2013. The following Windows OS versions have been impacted by this issue.

Windows® 7 / Windows® Vista / Windows® XP

If you are currently using the Windows OS and have installed the update in question, the opening cut scene of the FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn (Windows ver.) will not play properly.
* Please note that the issue has no impact on the PlayStation®3 version of FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn.

Please be patient as Microsoft is currently is working on addressing the issue.

Listed below is the current situation of the OS.

Windows® 7
A new Windows update has been released by Microsoft to address the issue. If you have not installed the most recent Windows update, please do so immediately.

While the OS should automatically update itself on the default settings, if your PC is not set to automatically download and install the most recent Windows updates, please visit the following URL to obtain the update.

https://technet.microsoft.com/en-us/security/bulletin/ms13-057

Windows® Vista ／Windows® XP
Microsoft is currently working on addressing the issue. Please wait for the official announcement by Microsoft regarding the release date of the update.

We will follow-up on this announcement once more information becomes available on the matter.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Procedures during Periods of High Congestion (Aug. 21)
We are expecting major congestion during the period starting with the Early Access on Aug. 24, 2013 at 2:00 a.m. (PDT) leading up to the official game launch on Aug. 27, 2013 (PDT).

If a large volume of players attempt to login to the game simultaneously, certain players may receive the following message: “This World is currently full. Players in queue: ##.” If you receive this message, we ask that you please wait until your login is processed.

Regarding the Issue Occurred on Beta Phase 4 (Aug. 22)
Thank you for playing FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn.

We are notifying about the issues that occurred and measures taken during the Beta Test Phase 4.

-For Worlds under the North America/European Data Centers, we have resolved the issue where in some cases Error 3102 was displayed and was not allowing login.

Since the detail of the error was that it occurs when a Character is left in a World for a short period of time, the error may display upon situations such as connection loss. Even in that case, we have fixed the issue so players are able to login again after a minute or so.

-We have resolved the issue where in some cases Error 90000 was displayed and was having login difficulty.

-We have resolved the issue where in some cases Error 90000 was displayed and players were unable to move to certain areas.

-We have resolved the issue where in some cases players were unable to complete Main Quests and Class Quests even though they were completed.

Also regarding the Beta Test Phase 4, we are currently fixing the data for Characters that had the corresponding issues.

*There are Quests that allows players to choose their rewards, but we have reports saying that the status of the selection stayed as unselected. For Quests that allows players to select their rewards, we please ask our players to select the rewards.

-We have resolved the issue where in some cases players were unable to complete certain Sub Quests even though they were completed.

Also regarding the Beta Test Phase 4, we are sorry to ask our players to abandon the Quest once and offer it again for the corresponding issues if occurred.

*There are Quests that allows players to choose their rewards, but we have reports saying that the status of the selection stayed as unselected. For Quests that allows players to select their rewards, we please ask our players to select the rewards.

-We have made a change, so when receiving damage during an Event and in some cases unable to progress in certain Quests, players will no longer receive damage.

Also, regarding the Beta Test Phase 4, we are sorry to ask our players to abandon the Quest once and offer it again for the corresponding issues if occurred.

-We have resolved the issue where in some cases players were unable to progress Guildleve Release Quest.

Also regarding the Beta Test Phase 4, we are currently fixing the data for Characters that had the corresponding issues.

-We have resolved the issue where in some cases the client program force quits when selecting a Character.

-We have resolved the issue when completing Thaumaturge and Fisher Class Release Quest, the amount of gear set increases by two.
*Gear sets normally increase by one

Also, if affected by this issue, some players will be at a disadvantage compared to other players so for the corresponding Characters, we are planning to implement a compensation. We will notify everyone once we decide on the compensation date and method.

-We have resolved the issue when in some cases during a server outage, the action to mount and call a Minion was disappearing.

Also, for Characters that have the call action disappear, the action has been reinstated.

-We have resolved the issue when in some cases during a server outage, Items that were stored in the Cabinet was disappearing.

Also, for Characters that have lost Items, what was in the Cabinet has been reinstated.

08/23/2013 3:25 PM
Current Known Issue (Aug. 23)
As of August 23, 2013, the following issues have been confirmed in FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn.

- An issue wherein the companion action "Choco Medica" does not recover HP properly.
* We plan to address this issue via a hot fix as soon as possible.

- An issue wherein the "manor sentries" that appear in the instanced dungeon "Haukke Manor" become stuck and prevent players from progressing through the instanced dungeon.
* Please be sure to fight the "manor sentries" on the second floor of the Haukke Manor until the issue is addressed.
* If you encounter this issue, please open the Duty Finder and then select "Leave."

- Due to a critical issue that we have identified in the instanced dungeon "The Wanderer's Palace," the instanced dungeon will not be available at launch.
* Please note that while the instanced dungeon "The Wanderer's Palace" will show up in the Duty Finder, it will be inaccessible. Please refrain from joining the instanced dungeon until the issue is addressed. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
*Fixed on Aug. 24, 2013 Instanced dungeon “The Wanderer's Palace” has been resolved. The Wanderer's Palace will be available at the start of Early Access as originally anticipated.

- An issue wherein if a player completes a primal battle while KO'd, the option to return to your home point will not appear.
* If you encounter this issue, please have a party member revive you or open the Duty Finder and then select "Leave."

- An issue wherein if a player joins an instance via the Duty Finder, they occasionally become immobilized after leaving the instance.
* If you encounter this issue, please contact a GM by selecting the "Support Desk" option under the system menu.

- An issue wherein certain cutscenes viewed from the "The Unending Journey" located in inn rooms will always play from the beginning.

- An issue wherein the icons on the market boards occasionally appear incorrectly while a player is experiencing lag.

- [PlayStation®3 only] An issue wherein a player will occasionally lose control of their character while fighting a certain monster in the instanced dungeon "The Sunken Temple of Qarn."
* If you encounter this issue, please log out and then back in.

- [PlayStation®3 only] An issue wherein the game client may freeze if a player attempts to log out while their character configuration screen is open.

- [PlayStation®3 only] An issue wherein the cursor location of the Crafting Log will occasionally appear in the incorrect location and prevents the players from controlling their characters.
* If you encounter this issue, please log out and then back in.

- [PlayStation®3 only] An issue wherein a player will occasionally be unable to take a screenshot.
* If the screenshot fails, the message "Screenshot failed." will appear.

08/24/2013 9:31 PM
Action Taken Towards Instances Issue (Aug. 24)
Hello, this is FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn Producer and Director, Yoshida.

Thank you for your cooperation on the multiple maintenance correspondence.

With the 2 maintenances that were implemented with the NA/EU Data Center, we have resolved the 90000 error origin and corresponding characters. For the few reports that have been sent after the maintenance, it seems like it is a separate issue, and we will be working on them individually. Thank you for your cooperation with the maintenance.

And we are also currently working on the an even better way to optimize the heavy load of simultaneous access, heavy load on matching and the matching server features for Duty Finder.

Since it is hard to implement them during peak hours and that it might make the matters worse, we are carefully deciding when to do it.

So at Aug. 25 12:00 a.m. PDT, we will be implementing a maintenance to optimize the NA/EU Data Centers. At the same time, we will be implementing all the fixes done for the NA/EU Data Centers to the JP Data Center, so maintenance will be done on the JP Data Centers to get a smoother optimization.

We apologize for the inconvenience that this is causing everyone, but we please ask for continued cooperation for an overall stable environment. The Development and Support Team will continue to work hard for smoother play to our customers, and we thank you for understanding and for your cooperation.

Precautions Concerning FINAL FANTASY XIV Licenses
Once FINAL FANTASY XIV is officially launched, players will need to use a registration code (for the Windows version of the game) or a product code (for the PlayStation® 3 version of the game) in order to obtain licenses for each respective platform. Please review the guidelines below in order to ensure that you successfully register your codes.

When registering an license, you will be able choose between registering it to an existing service account which you have previously played FINAL FANTASY XIV on, or registering it to a completely new service account.

We have received reports from players who, although they wished to continue playing the game post-launch with characters created either in the original FINAL FANTASY XIV or during the FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn beta test, have mistakenly registered their licenses to either the wrong service account, or to a brand new service account.
In order to prevent this from happening to you, please keep the following in mind.

* If you wish to play with a character from either the original FINAL FANTASY XIV or the FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn beta test:
- When going through the process to register your license, be sure to log in using the same login ID and password that you previously used when logging into the game to play with the character in question.
- Please do not select the “Create New Service Account” option
- If your account has only one FINAL FANTASY XIV service account, please select that option to continue.
- If your account is displaying multiple FINAL FANTASY XIV service accounts, please review the licenses already attached to each of these service accounts before selecting the service account you wish to register the license in question to.

* Regarding the display of licenses attached to service accounts -Upon selecting a service account, the currently registered licenses on it will be displayed. For your reference, the names and descriptions of each license are written below:

[Windows® Version]

[Follow-up]Regarding Preparations to Increase the Capacity of our Data Centers (Aug. 27)
Thank you very much for playing FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn.

We would like to make a clarification regarding our previous announcement “Regarding Congestion in Japan Data Center Worlds (Aug. 27)” in which we stated that we are preparing to increase the capacity of our data centers.

The first half of the announcement regarding login and character creation restrictions was directed towards our players who would be playing during peak hours in Japan data center Worlds.

However, the second half of the announcement regarding increasing the capacity of our data centers was meant to also encompass North American and European data center Worlds and not just be limited to Japan data center Worlds.

We deeply apologize for causing concern amongst the North American and European community due to our lack of clarity. Capacity will be increased for data centers in all regions.

Once again, thank you for your understanding and cooperation to help us welcome more players to the game.

Regarding Congestion in Japan Data Center Worlds (Aug. 27)
Thank you very much for playing FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn.

Currently, an extremely high number of players are enjoying the game. Should the number of players continue to increase at the current pace, there is the possibility that our expectations and server capacity will be greatly surpassed. Therefore, in order to maintain a stable gameplay environment, we are implementing login and character creation restrictions.

In order to be able to welcome a drastically greater number of players, we are starting as early as this week with preparations to increase our facilities, to be ready by early next week. Until that time, we will be continuing to implement these restrictions as required, and we ask for your understanding and patience.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, and once again thank you for your understanding and cooperation in this matter.

[Date & Time]
From Sep. 3, 2013 5:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. (PDT)

[Follow-up]Regarding the Character Appearance Change of Your Version 1.0 Characters (Sep. 5): Follow-up
We have determined our course of action to address the situation wherein players were unable the load their character data from the official benchmark when changing the appearance of their FINAL FANTASY XIV Version 1.0 characters. Please see the details below.

[Character Name Change]
If you experienced an issue when trying to change your Version 1.0 character's name upon logging into A Realm Reborn for the first time, please fill out and submit the form below by Sep. 10, 2013, 7:59 a.m. (PDT).

Character name changes will begin from Sep. 11, 2013 in the order in which they were received. After your request has been processed, the Character Name Change Screen will be displayed the next time you log in, and you will be able to change your character’s name.

Please note that once you receive the Character Name Change Screen, you will no longer be able to choose the same name your character currently possesses; you will have to choose a different name. Please be aware of this when you submit your request.

*Official Support Center Form
http://sqex.to/6Pq

[Character Appearance Change]
Players that experienced issues changing the appearance of their FINAL FANTASY XIV Version 1.0 character when starting A Realm Reborn will receive a consumable in-game item called “Fantasia.” Using the item in game will allow you the opportunity to edit your character's appearance. The Fantasia will be sent via the Moogle Delivery Service in the order in which requests were received.

Please note that because Fantasia is a rare item, a character cannot possess more than one at a time. If you already possess a Fantasia (obtained as a Veteran Reward, for example), please use your existing Fantasia in your inventory before receiving the new one from the Moogle Delivery Service.

title: News
body:
09/04/2013 4:33 AM
Regarding Results of Maintenance (Sep. 4)
The following are the results of the maintenance that occurred on Sep. 3, 2013 from around 5:00 p.m. to Sep. 4, 2013 around 2:10 a.m. (PDT).

-Alleviating Stress on Duty Finder Servers This maintenance has implemented countermeasures to alleviate the stress on servers. Previously, matching took place across all servers in the various region data centers, but following this maintenance, matching will now take place within the selected groups below.

*Japan Data Center
-Group 1
Aegis / Alexander / Atomos / Carbuncle / Chocobo /
Gungnir / Ifrit / Ixion / Ramuh / Ridill / Titan /
Typhon / Valefor

-Group 2
Anima / Bahamut / Durandal / Fenrir / Garuda / Hades /
Kujata / Mandragora / Masamune / Tiamat / Tonberry /
Ultima

*North American/European Data Centers
-Group 1
Adamantoise / Balmung / Cactuar / Diabolos / Exodus /
Goblin / Hyperion / Lamia / Malboro / Moogle / Odin /
Ragnarok / Siren

-Group 2
Behemoth / Cerberus / Coeurl / Excalibur / Faerie /
Gilgamesh / Leviathan / Midgardsormr / Phoenix /
Sargatanas / Shiva / Ultros

-Login Restrictions
In the time period just after maintenance has completed, we predict a rush of characters logging in simultaneously. In order to prevent any technical difficulties due to this login rush, we will be temporarily placing severe login restrictions. These login restrictions may occur frequently, lasting from a few minutes to ten minutes; however, restrictions will be lifted in a gradual manner as login status is carefully monitored. We ask for your patience and understanding in this matter.

Furthermore, as a result of the countermeasures taken to alleviate stress on the Duty Finder servers, we expect to be able to increase the number of players able to login simultaneously; however, if those login numbers still surpass the maximum number of possible logins in the various Worlds, please be aware that we will continue to implement login restrictions.

-Regarding Limits on New Character Creation As a result of this maintenance, it is now possible to accommodate an increased number of simultaneous logins in the various Worlds; therefore, we have now lifted the New Character Creation restrictions in the majority of Worlds in which restrictions were in effect. New players who are just starting a game or those who would simply like to create a new character can do so by finding a World which has had the restrictions lifted, and creating a character there.

Please note that there is a tendency for characters to become concentrated in certain Worlds, causing login numbers to jump up in those particular Worlds. In order to create a population balance between Worlds, we will continue to be implementing New Character Creation restrictions in overly congested Worlds.

We will monitor the situation, and in the event restrictions may be lifted, follow-up news posts will be posted. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and ask for your patience and understanding.

-Addition of New Worlds
With this maintenance, preparation for the addition of new Worlds has been completed.

Although it is possible to add several new Worlds due to load balancing on servers, an increased number of players able to login simultaneously to various Worlds, and New Character Creation being possible again on various Worlds as a result of this maintenance, we will only be adding a minimal number of Worlds at this time directly after maintenance.

At this time, the following new Worlds have been added.

*Japan Data Center
-Pandemonium

*North American/European data center
-Famfrit / Lich (Europe-recommended World)

Please note that, after a new World opens, we predict players will be concentrated in that specific World. In order to create a population balance, please be aware that we will be implementing New Character Creation restrictions or login restrictions in overly congested Worlds.

We will continue with the addition of new Worlds as we monitor the login situation and public opinion in real time, and updates of any new Worlds will be posted.

[Important]Improving the Security of Your Account
Recently we have seen a rise in reports of player accounts being compromised. In order to better safeguard your account's security, please take a moment to review the following tips:

- Avoid sharing account passwords across multiple online services Please note that if you use the same account name or password as your Square Enix account on other online services, a security breach at any of the other online services could potentially lead to your Square Enix account being compromised.

- Use complex passwords that are resistant to guessing If you use repeated strings of characters, phone numbers, birth dates, or other information that may be tied to your identity, this may make it possible for individuals to access your account simply by guessing its password.

- Change your password
If your current password does not adhere to the guidelines listed above, or if you believe that there is any possibility of your password having been compromised, we recommend that you change your password by going to the following page:

https://secure.square-enix.com/account/app/svc/reminder?

- Add extra security to your account with a Security Token or Software Token

To further strengthen the security of your Square Enix account, we highly recommend using a Square Enix Security Token or Software Token to act as an extra layer of protection against unauthorized access.

A free, downloadable smartphone app is available at the following locations:

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.square_enix_software_token

Itunes: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/square-enix-software-token/id617970570?mt=8

Physical security tokens are also available for purchase here:
http://www.square-enix.com/na/account/otp/

Also, please note that accounts that are suspected of having been compromised will have their access temporarily restricted. Once login has been restricted, an email notification will be sent to the primary email address registered to the Square Enix account. Regarding Details of Recent Maintenance (Sep. 12)
The following are details regarding the maintenance operation that occurred on Sep. 11, 2013 from 4:00 p.m. to 12:55 a.m. (PDT).

[Countermeasures to Relieve Heavy Server Stress on Duty Finder]
This maintenance implemented countermeasures to further relieve heavy server stress on the Duty Finder and instance-related Worlds.

With this measure, group matching is now split among the following three groups for the selection process.

- Japan data center
- Group 1
Aegis/Atomos/Carbuncle/Garuda/Gungnir/Kujata/Ramuh/Tonberry/Typhon/Unicorn

- Group 2
Alexander/Bahamut/Durandal/Fenrir/Ifrit/Ridill/Tiamat/Ultima/Valefor/Yojimbo/Zeromus

- Group 3
Anima/Chocobo/Hades/Ixion/Mandragora/Masamune/Pandaemonium/Titan/Asura/Belias

- North American/European data center
- Group 1
Adamantoise/Balmung/Cerberus/Coeurl/Faerie/Goblin/Midgardsormr/Odin/Sargatanas/Siren

- Group 2
Behemoth/Diabolos/Excalibur/Famfrit/Lamia/Leviathan/Lich/Shiva/Ultros/Brynhildr

- Group 3
Cactuar/Exodus/Gilgamesh/Hyperion/Malboro/Moogle/Phoenix/Ragnarok/Mateus/Zalera

*Groupings are determined by balancing levels, number of people, class/jobs, and adjusted so as to help provide a smooth matching process.

[Increased Number of Instance Worlds]
The Duty Finder and quest instance battles are handled internally in their own separate Worlds. In addition to the above measure of easing server load by splitting the selection pool amongst the above groups, we have also increased the number of instance-related Worlds on which battles occur.
This measure allows the facilitation of more instances, decreasing cases in which players must wait for an instance to become open after they have already been matched by the Duty Finder or the quest instance battle has been initiated.

[Addition of New Worlds]
We have implemented the addition of the following Worlds.

- Japan data center
Unicorn/Yojimbo/Asura/Belias/Zeromus

- North American/European data center
Mateus/Brynhildr/Zalera

Please note that, upon first opening of the new Worlds, we predict a concentrated influx of characters in the low-level zones of said Worlds. Therefore, until characters have evened out and dispersed into the various zones, we will be implementing Character Creation and login restrictions. Please be aware.

In addition, as a result of splitting the group matching for the Duty Finder into 3 groups, we are now able to expand our services easier. We will continue to monitor concurrent logins and the increase of new players in each World and, if needed, periodically add new Worlds starting from October.

We will announce details regarding this at a later time.

[Implementation of Auto-Logout]
Because there are so many users attempting to login even when the maximum allowed number of concurrent logins has already been reached (in other words, when login restrictions are in place), we have now implemented an auto-logout feature. In an attempt to provide as many users as possible a chance to login, characters that appear to be inactive for thirty minutes will be automatically logged out of the game.

[Login Restrictions Directly After Maintenance]
In the time period just after maintenance has completed, we predict a rush of characters logging in simultaneously. In order to prevent any technical difficulties due to this login rush, we will be temporarily placing severe login restrictions. These login restrictions may occur frequently, lasting from a few minutes to ten minutes; however, restrictions will be lifted in a gradual manner as login status is carefully monitored. We ask for your patience and understanding in this matter.

title: News

09/18/2013 10:48 AM
Important Notice to All Software Token Users (Sep. 18)
This is a notice to all customers who use a Square Enix Software Token (Software Token). If you are using a Software Token on your smartphone and decide to switch to a new phone, or you have deleted your Software Token application, you will need to use your Software Token’s Emergency Removal Password to remove your Software Token from the old device, after which you must re-register the token to your new device. If you are planning on switching phones or deleting the application, please be sure you have your Emergency Removal Password at hand first. *In the case you cannot perform an emergency removal of the Software Token, you will no longer be able to log in to or use the various services related to your applicable Square Enix account. How to confirm your Software Token Emergency Removal Password (1) Log in to the Square Enix Account Management System. Square Enix Account Management System: http://sqex.to/KeD (2) After you have logged into the Square Enix Account Management System, your Emergency Removal Password will be displayed under “Token Usage Status” below the “Square Enix Account Information” section at the right side of the screen. *The Emergency Removal Password is a one-time password that changes after each use. After you have used it, you must log into the Square Enix Account Management System again to obtain your new one-time Emergency Removal Password. Before you switch phones or delete the application, please be sure to follow the above steps to confirm and store your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. After you have switched phones or deleted your application, this password will be necessary to perform the Emergency Removal of the Software Token registered to your old device. How to perform an emergency removal of your Software Token (1) Go to the Software Token Emergency Removal page and enter your Square Enix ID and password and your Emergency Removal Password. Software Token Emergency Removal page: http://sqex.to/GPE (2) An email containing the Software Token removal URL will be sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account. (3) Click on the URL to remove your Software Token. * Note that the URL will expire after 60 minutes. Please be sure to click on it and complete the removal of your Software Token before it expires. How to Re-register your Software Token * You may also review the steps for re-registering your Software Token in the page below. http://www.square-enix.com/na/account/otp/token.html (1) Log into the Square Enix Account Management System with the Square Enix account you wish to register your Software Token to. Square Enix Account Management System: http://sqex.to/GPE (2) Open the “One-Time Password” page found below the “Services and Options” category. (3) Select “Configure Software Token Application” at the bottom of the page and choose “Software Token Registration.” (4) Select either “Software Token for iPhone and iPod touch” or “Software Token for Android” depending on the type of operating system installed on your device. (You will be taken to the AppStore or GooglePlay website according to your selection.) * Please do not close the Square Enix Account Management System window as you will need to come back to it later. * Once your application finishes downloading, please return to the Square Enix Account Management System window and continue with the steps below. (5) Click on “Next” in the “Software Token Registration” page. (6) Carefully review the terms of use and click on “Agree to Agreement and Send Confirmation Mail.” (7) A registration password will be sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account. (8) Launch the application after it has been installed, choose your language, and then enter your Square Enix ID, registered date of birth, and the registration password that was sent to you. This will complete the Software Token registration. * Please be aware that the Software Token registration cannot be completed until you enter your Square Enix ID, date of birth, and registration password into the application. * The registration password will expire after 60 minutes. If your password expires, you must restart the re-registration process from step 1. * The “Registration Password” refers to the password that is sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account in step 7. Please use caution as it is not the same as your Square Enix account password. If you have lost your Emergency Removal Password or are unable to perform the emergency removal of the Software Token yourself, the Support Center will be able to remove it for you once account ownership is verified. Please review the FAQ below for further details. How do I remove the Square Enix Security Token from my account? http://sqex.to/mVZ If you have any questions or concerns regarding the steps described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center. Square Enix Support Center http://support.na.square-enix.com/

Regarding Actions Taken Against In-Game RMT Ads and Illicit Activities (Oct. 1)
RMT and other illicit activities upset the balance of the game and, as such, are prohibited under the Terms of Service.

Because we have confirmed the existence of players who are engaging in these illicit activities, we have taken the actions listed below.

- Date: Sep. 12 – Sep. 30, 2013

- Accounts receiving disciplinary action for illicit activity: 156 accounts
- Action Details: Termination from FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn

- Accounts receiving disciplinary action for RMT/illicit activities: 568 accounts
- Action Details: Termination/Temporary suspension from FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn
* Accounts of egregious violators will be terminated.

- Total Frozen Gil: Approximately 367,700 million Gil
* Gil of temporarily suspended accounts will be confiscated.

Included in the above are players who used/obtained gil, items, or actions through fraudulent means. Although we are taking the utmost care and attention to prevent such actions, players who discover any confirmed cheats should, under no circumstances, exploit or disseminate such information. Instead, we ask that players file a report by using the in-game command [System Menu] -> [Support Desk] -> [Contact Us] -> [Report Cheating].

In addition, the recent maintenance operations have implemented countermeasures to nullify the effects of the aforementioned cheats.

We will continue to take stringent disciplinary action against any accounts with confirmed involvement in RMT/illicit activity; players should take care to steer clear of any activity that violates the Terms of Service. Please be forewarned.

* "Cheating" consists of using third party programs or tools to conduct actions players would not normally be able to do in the game (for example, obtaining gil or items through illicit means, traversing at extremely high speeds, warping, using automated means to operate your character while you are away from the game).

title: News
body:
11/08/2013 3:55 AM
Countermeasures for the Fraud Using Market (Nov. 8)
Here is a message from Producer/Director Yoshida regarding the current security issue and action that will be taken from this point on for the Market.
-------------------
This is Producer/Director Yoshida.

This is a thread, but I would like to mention the current situation and actions that we are going to take from this point on.

First of all, a few hours ago, we received several reports about fraud wherein certain functions of the Market were abused by an outside source.
There are not many reported incidents due to this, but to prevent any further occurrences, we performed an emergency maintenance.

We sincerely apologize for the trouble this has caused for the players affected by this issue.
We are verifying the data and promise that everything will be kept safe.

This issue can only be seen in certain Worlds, zones and circumstances, so it will not affect players that are not logged in.

Once we resolve the issue and assure the safety of the situation, alongside the recovery of the game, we will take action towards the outside fraud source and take security countermeasures.

Again, we apologize for the inconvenience that this may have caused.
-------------------
We are not planning to do any sizable data rollbacks at this time for this situation.
We are essentially planning to correspond with the players whose data was affected.

We have obtained information of the route and IP address of the source and we are planning to take legal actions regarding this fraud.
-------------------
This is Producer/Director Yoshida.

Since there is a risk of attack and harassment if we post details about this issue, we will be avoiding doing so and wish you will understand.
There are several posts here, but there are comments where users seemed to have misread some of them, so here is a brief explanation of the entire situation and about the emergency shutdown below.

*Regarding the origin of the issue and the affected situation*

Amount Affected: Approx. 200 cases

Requirement: Must be logged in
Place of Occurrence: Only in certain, specific Worlds
Area of Occurrence: Only when in certain zones
Requirements: Only when having more than several thousand Gil (Excluding the amount on retainers)

The issue will only occur if you fall into all of the requirements listed above, and also if the third-party fraud targets you.

Resolving Method: No sizable rollbacks; Each case will be addressed by our Operations Team

Since we are steadily handling everyone’s data, as mentioned previously, we would like to let those affected by this issue know that they will be contacted by the Operations Team individually, and that we will attend to the data recovery promptly.

We are currently creating a flow to carry this out, and will be starting once it’s finalized.

*Regarding the Emergency World Shutdown*

Since this emergency maintenance was overlapping with another maintenance that was planned earlier, we apologize or any confusion that this may have caused.

As soon as this issue was escalated to Yoshida, the Operations Team corresponded with the “Emergency Flow Procedure” and proceeded with the announcement.
Even though this flow is considered for the player’s play experience and allowing some time before the World’s shutdown, this issue was possible that it was an attack from an outside source and being too urgent, Yoshida decided that the implementation of the early World shutdown was better to be immediate. If a post were to be made about the World shutdown, he thought that the attacker may have increased the speed of the attack and made the matter worse.
Although our intentions were for the best and to prevent further widespread occurrences, we apologize that this caused inconvenience to our players who were playing at the time of the shutdown.

Also, for future announcements regarding this issue, we will be posting News as well with this thread, and are currently implementing an emergency flow. We please ask our players to understand and thank you for your patience.

As for the recovery of all Worlds, this may take some time and will be notifying everyone as soon as any updates are available.

Issue Regarding Incorrect Company Actions (Dec. 17)
We have confirmed an issue wherein company actions that were purchased before the release of patch 2.1 were changed to different actions after the version update. Upon investigating the matter, we found that this was an unexpected side effect from changes made to the internal IDs of company actions.

After discussing on how to address this issue, we determined that players would be negatively impacted if we simply rolled back these internal IDs. Therefore, during the next maintenance operation, we will be reimbursing 17,500 company credits, the highest amount lost due to this issue, to all free companies that are rank 5 or above as of the start of that maintenance.

We will make another announcement when this reimbursement is completed.

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused by this issue and thank you for your patience.

--------------------------------------------
*Edit: Added Jan. 21, 2014 2:20 a.m. (PST)
As of the maintenance which occurred from Jan. 20, 2014 8:00 p.m. (PST) to Jan. 21, 2014 1:00 a.m., reimbursement of company credits was performed in response to this issue.

Housing Price Adjustments (Dec .26)
As mentioned previously on the official forums ( http://sqex.to/-e5 ), the pricing of land for legacy Worlds will be adjusted in incremental steps to match the pricing of the following non-legacy Worlds (Hereafter referred to as Group A):

Bahamut／Behemoth／Cactuar／Carbuncle／Chocobo／Diabolos／Fenrir／Garuda／Gilgamesh／Ifrit／Leviathan／Mandragora／Midgardsormr／Odin／Ramuh／Shiva／Siren／Tiamat／Titan／Tonberry／Ultros

Pricing for the following legacy Worlds is currently set at 2.5 times the amount of those in Group A (Hereafter referred to as Group B):
Balmung／Excalibur／Hyperion／Ragnarok／Sargatanas

The final price of land for Group B will first be reduced from 2.5 to 2.25 times the amount of Group A. Over the course of the next week, the price will be reduced from 2.25 to 2 times the amount of Group A. Over the course of six weeks, the final price of land for Group B will continue to drop until it has reached the same value as Group A.
* Adjustments to pricing will apply to all plot sizes.

Pricing for the following legacy Worlds is currently set at 5 times the amount of those in Group A (Hereafter referred to as Group C):
Aegis／Durandal／Gungnir／Masamune／Ridill
The final price of land for Group C will first be reduced from 5.0 to 4.5 times the amount of Group A. Over the course of the next week, the price will be reduced from 4.5 to 4 times the amount of Group A. Over the course of eight weeks, the final price of land for Group C will continue to drop until it has reached the same value as Group A.

Furthermore, the final price of land across all Worlds will be re-evaluated at some point in the latter half of January. Please be advised that the pricing of land on all Worlds will be subject to change even after the above adjustments have been made.

02/20/2014 9:28 PM
[PS4™ Version] Current Known Issues with the FINAL FANTASY XIV PS4™ Beta Test Version
A number of issues with Japanese text entry have been confirmed in the FINAL FANTASY XIV PS4™ Beta version.

Issues Affecting Japanese Text Entry

- Pressing the Ctrl, Alt & Shift keys under certain conditions may result in text entry data being assigned to the wrong key. Then, attempting to select and use text entry features in FFXIV (such as chat or mail) at this time will result in the text appearing automatically on the entry field as characters from the incorrectly assigned key.

We have employed some temporary measures on the application side to help prevent this issue from occurring, but were unable to completely prevent these keys from being assigned incorrectly. However, these countermeasures have unexpectedly lead to slower processing speed when entering text.

- When entering text in Japanese, while converting pre-formatted text to a set “Auto-translate” phrase, hitting the ←arrow key or Enter key at the start of the character string will cause the pre-converted text to appear instead.

Fix schedule

We are working to address this issue in an upcoming system software update for the PlayStation®4.
Once the modified system software is ready, we will also implement a patch or update to the FFXIV application to coincide with the system software update, which should resolve the problem.

Until then, issues with the text system will affect the input speed of Japanese language entry for players. We apologize for any inconvenience, and will provide further information once the dates for this update have been finalized.

[Important]Important Notice for FFXIV: ARR PlayStation®4 Beta Test Users (Apr. 3)
We have confirmed an issue wherein North American users who have downloaded the FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn (Beta Version) on the PlayStation®4 between Tuesday, April 1, and Thursday, April 3, at 4:00 p.m. (PDT) will be unable to properly log into the game.

If you have downloaded the Beta during the aforementioned time, you will need to return to PlayStation®Store and make your purchase again to resolve the issue. You will not need to re-download the software.

Here are the steps you will need to take to be able to correct the issue and participate in the Beta Test.

1. Log into the Sony Entertainment Network account that you used to download the Beta Test software.
2. On the PlayStation 4 home screen, navigate to PlayStation®Store and launch it.
3. On the menu, select “Games” > “New” > “New This Month” and navigate to the “FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn” content and select it.
4. Select “Add to Cart” and “Proceed to Checkout” and finally “Confirm Purchase”.

To confirm the issue has been resolved, simply navigate to the “Settings” menu on the PlayStation®4 home screen, select PSN℠ > Account Information > Services List > and select “FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn” where it should display “Open Beta 2 Entitlement” if the issue has been resolved.

The issue has been addressed for those downloading the Beta Test software from PlayStation®Store going forward.

04/11/2014 3:45 AM
Login and Character Creation Restrictions (Apr. 11)
Depending on the level of congestion during the PlayStation®4 early access/formal start of service, we may enforce a temporary restriction on logins and/or character creation.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, but as this is a countermeasure to prevent anticipated congestion, crowded Worlds, and server outages, we ask for your patience and thank you for your understanding.

[Login Restrictions]
During periods of high congestion, we may place a limit on the number of players allowed to log in at any one time. Should this happen, the message “This World is currently full. Players in queue: [number],” will appear. We ask that you please wait in this queue until you are able to log in.
Additionally, depending on the number of simultaneous connections or server load, login restrictions may be enforced. Should this happen, the message “This World is currently full. Please wait until an opening is available and try again,” will appear, and you will be unable to log in. We ask that you please wait before trying again.

[Character Creation Restrictions]
We may place character creation restrictions on individual Worlds based on our real-time observations of the number of characters, simultaneous connections, and server load.
We are anticipating a high character population in low-level areas due to new characters being created. Although individual areas have set population limits, there is a worry that players will be unable to log in or that servers may go down as the character count approaches these limits. Because of this, we will be closely monitoring server conditions and adjust character creation restrictions as necessary.

title: News
body:
05/08/2014 7:30 AM
[Important]Warning Regarding Phishing Emails/Messages
As we have informed you previously, we have confirmed that certain individuals are attempting to direct players to a fake log-in page for the Square Enix Account Management System in an attempt to steal (also known as “phishing”) their Square Enix ID and password, as well as other sensitive information such as birthdate. Please be very cautious as the contents of the fake websites and fake emails are being cleverly disguised.

In addition, we have also recently confirmed phishing attempts that direct players to fake pages imitating Square Enix's Support Center, as well as Lodestone.

In order to keep your personal information and game data safe, we urge you to exercise caution to avoid these emails and websites.

[Characteristics of the fake websites]

- The “s” is missing from “https” in the URL of the login page The fake website will display http:// in the URL

- The hyphen symbol is missing from “square-enix”
The fake website will display “squareenix” in the URL

- The letter “I” is replaced with either “l” or “j”
The fake website will display “square-enlx” or “square-enjx”

- The “com” in “square-enix.com” is replaced by various domains

* There is a possibility that these same scammers will continue to change their methods in their attempt to steal personal information. The above characteristics are examples we have confirmed.

[Characteristics of fake emails]

- The email will contain a message stating that a user agreement violation, suspicious activity, or billing issue has been confirmed and will ask the recipient to go to the fake website.
* A legitimate email from Square Enix may contain the same content, as the scammers copy and paste the text from our emails in most cases.

- The fake URL is hyperlinked to the body text
* The email will contain the official URL for the Square Enix Account Management System (https://secure.square-enix.com/account/ ) in the body text, but it is actually hyperlinked to the fake website.
* This disguise can be especially easy to miss, so please be very careful.

- The senders disguise themselves by using an official email address
* The scammers have been confirmed to use our official email address like the one below.
autoinfo_na@account.square-enix.com

In some cases, the sender will assume the identity of the Square Enix Account Management System or Square Enix MEMBERS representative and use the Japanese names for these services.
(Example: スクウェア・エニックス アカウント管理システム / メンバーズ事務局)

* There is a possibility that these same scammers will continue to change their methods in their attempt to steal personal information. The above characteristics are examples we have confirmed.

[How to detect a fake website]

Before you access the website:
- If you need to click on a link included in an email or website, please confirm that the URL is legitimate.
* The official URL for the Square Enix Account Management System is https://secure.square-enix.com/account/

- Check that the link displayed is not hyperlinked to a fake URL
* Mouse over the link in your internet browser or email program to display the URL contained in the link and confirm that it is legitimate.

If you already accessed the website:
- Confirm that the website is legitimate
*The Square Enix Account Management System website complies with EV SSL certification. If you access a legitimate website, your browser’s address bar will turn green and you will see “SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD.” as the website administrator on the right or left hand side. Before you ever enter personal information such as your Square Enix Account number or password, please make absolutely sure to confirm that the website is legitimate by checking to see whether the green “SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD.” is displayed as the website administrator.

*At these phishing sites, players will be prompted to enter their Square Enix Account number and password. Please be aware that on a legitimate site which shows “SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD.” as the website administrator, there will be no other pages apart from the login page that require you to enter password information, nor will any of our staff ever ask you for your password.

*For more information on EV SSL certification, please visit the website below.
https://www.symantec.com/page.jsp?id=how-ssl-works

*URL to the official Square Enix Account Management System
https://secure.square-enix.com/account/

*URL to the official Square Enix Support Center
http://support.na.square-enix.com/
http://support.na.square-enix.com/main.php?id=5382&la=1

*URL to the official Lodestone
http://na.finalfantasyxiv.com/lodestone/

If you have accidentally entered your Square Enix ID and password into the fake website or simply clicked on the false URL, you should run your anti-malware or anti-virus software and change your password immediately.

Changing your password
http://sqex.to/xPt

Also, we strongly recommend players to use a Square Enix Security Token which will vastly improve account security.

About the Square Enix Security Token
http://www.square-enix.com/na/account/otp/

Please also refer to the following article entitled "Warning Concerning the Security of Your Account":
http://na.finalfantasyxiv.com/lodestone/news/detail/7360774bfa00f42c1264a0d58b41eaefc2aeef7b

Keep your personal information safe! Keep your Square Enix ID and password secure!

title: News
body:
06/06/2014 7:22 AM
Current Known Issues Occurring After Patch 2.28 (Jun. 6)
Currently, we have confirmed the following issues. The issues are being addressed, and we ask for your patience and understanding.

[Current Known Issues]
■An issue with Grand Company supply missions wherein HQ gear or gear with affixed materia cannot be delivered.
■An issue wherein Alexandrite cannot be obtained after completing a FATE with the “Holy Shield Animus” if the “Curtana Animus” has already been upgraded into the Novus first.

We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

*Edited on Jun. 13, 2014 at 2:42 a.m. (PDT)
・Moved some issues which were fixed to the section below.

[Fixed Issues]
The following issues have been addressed. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

■An issue in The Whorleater (Hard) and The Whorleater (Extreme) wherein Tidal Wave cannot be blocked if two or more players simultaneously use the Elemental Converter.
■An issue with Grand Company supply missions wherein supply and provisioning missions will not reset even though the next mission allowance has passed.
■An issue wherein monsters appear in an area where they cannot be fought when trying to progress the Peisteskin Treasure Map treasure hunt in Upper La Noscea .
■An issue wherein the potential of the following materia affixed to fishing gear will reset to 0.
Gatherer’s Guile / Gatherer’s Guerdon / Gatherer’s Grasp / Craftman’s Competence / Craftman’s Cunning / Craftman’s Command
■An issue wherein certain gear sets may cause actions to not be properly registered to the hotbar or cross hotbar.
■An issue wherein using Repair will occasionally render the player unable to take any action besides basic movement.
■An issue wherein Sightseeing Log entry #032 cannot be completed.

* Added Sep. 6, 2014 8:10 a.m. (PDT)
The issue was addressed during the maintenance that was conducted from Jul. 7, 2014 8:00 p.m. (PDT) to Jul. 8, 2014 2:00 a.m. (PDT).

Confirmed Issue Regarding Housing Functions (Jun. 11)
We have confirmed an issue occurring since the maintenance which took place on Jun. 9, 2014 wherein players will become unable to use housing functions if private aetherytes are newly placed within the property (garden).

We are working on the issue and plan to have it addressed within the week. Until then, we ask that players please refrain from the placing of any private aetherytes on their property.

Please note, this issue will not affect those who placed private aetherytes on their property prior to the Jun. 9, 2014 maintenance.

We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

Current Known Issues Occurring After Patch 2.28 (Jun. 18)
Currently, we have confirmed the following issue. The issue is being addressed, and we ask for your patience and understanding.

[Current Known Issues]
■An issue wherein macros registered to the hotbar or cross hotbar may not stay registered in the position in which they were set, instead switching out with other macro numbers, including numbers with no macros yet attached.

*We are currently investigating the matter thoroughly, and have confirmed that the act of changing the gear set number is one of the causes of this issue. For this reason, we ask that players refrain from changing their gear set numbers until this issue has been resolved.

Should you encounter this issue, we are sorry but ask that you simply re-register your preferred macros to the hotbar or cross hotbar again.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

07/09/2014 6:18 AM
On Frontline Matchmaking Improvements
Currently, we have found that wait times in the Duty Finder matchmaking process for Frontline campaigns are being affected by delays due to players abandoning the queue.

We are therefore planning to implement the following measures in order to address this issue.

[Measure 1]
In this measure, all players who choose “Commence” will be sent to the Frontline once matchmaking is complete, regardless of whether some have chosen “Abandon” at the last second or selected no option at all. This measure is scheduled to be introduced this week on July 11, 2014.

This may result in some teams starting the duty with an insufficient number of players. If this should happen, we ask that party leaders use the “Add Member” option to fill out their party’s numbers. Additionally, when registering for a Frontline campaign we recommend checking “Join Party in Progress,” which will make the matchmaking process smoother, and ask players to consider choosing this option whenever possible.

[Measure 2]
To address parties starting the duty with insufficient numbers, we are planning the addition of a feature which automatically adds members if required once duty has commenced. This countermeasure is planned for Frontline campaigns only and is scheduled for implementation sometime next week.

We will provide further details concerning both measures once they have been fully implemented, and ask for your patience until updated information can be provided.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

[Important]Important Notice to All Software Token Users
This is a notice to all customers who use a Square Enix Software Token (Software Token).

If you are using a Software Token on your smartphone and decide to switch to a new phone or update your device's operating system, or you have deleted your Software Token application, you will need to use your Software Token’s Emergency Removal Password to remove your Software Token from the old device, after which you must re-register the token to your new device. If you are planning on switching phones or deleting the application, please be sure you have your Emergency Removal Password at hand first.

*In the case you cannot perform an emergency removal of the Software Token, you will no longer be able to log in to or use the various services related to your applicable Square Enix account.

How to confirm your Software Token Emergency Removal Password

(1) Log in to the Square Enix Account Management System.

Square Enix Account Management System:
http://sqex.to/KeD

(2) After you have logged into the Square Enix Account Management System, your Emergency Removal Password will be displayed under “Token Usage Status” below the “Square Enix Account Information” section at the right side of the screen.

*The Emergency Removal Password is a one-time password that changes after each use. After you have used it, you must log into the Square Enix Account Management System again to obtain your new one-time Emergency Removal Password.

Before you switch phones or delete the application, please be sure to follow the above steps to confirm and store your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. After you have switched phones or deleted your application, this password will be necessary to perform the Emergency Removal of the Software Token registered to your old device.

How to perform an emergency removal of your Software Token

(1) Go to the Software Token Emergency Removal page and enter your Square Enix ID and password and your Emergency Removal Password.

Software Token Emergency Removal page:
http://sqex.to/GPE

(2) An email containing the Software Token removal URL will be sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account.

(3) Click on the URL to remove your Software Token.
* Note that the URL will expire after 60 minutes. Please be sure to click on it and complete the removal of your Software Token before it expires.

How to Re-register your Software Token
* You may also review the steps for re-registering your Software Token in the page below.
http://www.square-enix.com/na/account/otp/token.html

(1) Log into the Square Enix Account Management System with the Square Enix account you wish to register your Software Token to.

Square Enix Account Management System:
http://sqex.to/KeD

(2) Open the “One-Time Password” page found below the “Services and Options” category.

(3) Select “Configure Software Token Application” at the bottom of the page and choose “Software Token Registration.”

(4) Select either “Software Token for iPhone and iPod touch” or “Software Token for Android” depending on the type of operating system installed on your device.
(You will be taken to the AppStore or GooglePlay website according to your selection.)

* Please do not close the Square Enix Account Management System window as you will need to come back to it later.
* Once your application finishes downloading, please return to the Square Enix Account Management System window and continue with the steps below.

(5) Click on “Next” in the “Software Token Registration” page.

(6) Carefully review the terms of use and click on “Agree to Agreement and Send Confirmation Mail.”

(7) A registration password will be sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account.

(8) Launch the application after it has been installed, choose your language, and then enter your Square Enix ID, registered date of birth, and the registration password that was sent to you. This will complete the Software Token registration.

* Please be aware that the Software Token registration cannot be completed until you enter your Square Enix ID, date of birth, and registration password into the application.
* The registration password will expire after 60 minutes. If your password expires, you must restart the re-registration process from step 1.
* The “Registration Password” refers to the password that is sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account in step 7. Please use caution as it is not the same as your Square Enix account password.

If you have lost your Emergency Removal Password or are unable to perform the emergency removal of the Software Token yourself, the Support Center will be able to remove it for you once account ownership is verified. Please review the FAQ below for further details.

How do I remove the Square Enix Security Token from my account?
http://sqex.to/mVZ

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the steps described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center.

Square Enix Support Center
http://support.na.square-enix.com/

Known Issue after Patch 2.4 (Oct. 31)
The following issue has been confirmed to be occurring in Patch 2.4.
The issue is being addressed, and we ask for your patience and understanding as we resolve this promptly.

[Known Issue]

■When the following items are HQ, the “GP” stat is higher than intended, which resulted in equipped materia having a lower value.

Miner’s Shirt / Botanist’s Doublet / Fisher’s Shirt / Miner’s Gloves / Botanist’s Gloves / Fisher’s Gloves / Militia Bracelets

We would like to provide clarification on this issue:
One of Patch 2.3’s changes was “The GP cap when affixing materia to accessories item level 55 or above has been increased.” This entailed that values granted to existing items would not change. However, with Patch 2.4’s addition of new items and data reconfiguration, the above items had their values changed.

As a result, an upcoming hotfix will revert these items’ values back to before the error caused by Patch 2.4.

In future patches where we include new items, there is a possibility that item data will be changed. At those times, please consult the patch notes for more details.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused, and thank you for your understanding.

body:
11/05/2014 11:10 AM
Known Issue after Patch 2.4 (Nov. 5)
The following issue has been confirmed to be occurring in Patch 2.4. The issue is being addressed, and we ask for your patience and understanding as we resolve this promptly.

[Known Issue]

- It is possible to stable your chocobo at both your free company house and personal house at the same time.

When a chocobo is stabled at each stable, separate data is created. Although the All Worlds Maintenance (Nov. 5) will resolve this issue, if you have tended to your chocobo at either stable under these circumstances, we ask that you please follow the steps below to fetch your chocobo.

- If you tended to your chocobo stabled at your personal house:
Fetch your chocobo from your free company house stable. You will only be able to fetch your chocobo from your personal house after the fix, and the data for the chocobo stabled at the personal house stable will be used.

- If you tended to your chocobo stabled at your free company house:
Fetch your chocobo from your personal house stable. You will only be able to fetch your chocobo from your free company house after the fix, and the data for the chocobo stabled at the free company house stable will be used.

Additionally, if you leave your chocobo stabled at both locations, only your free company house-stabled chocobo’s data will be saved.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and thank you for your understanding.

* Added Nov. 11, 2014 7:00 p.m. (PST)
The issue was addressed during the maintenance that was conducted from Nov. 5, 2014 11:00 p.m. (PST) to Nov. 6, 2014 2:00 a.m. (PST).

Issue-Addressing Changes to Mechanics in Final Coil of Bahamut - Turn 3 (Nov. 6)
We have confirmed an issue in “The Final Coil of Bahamut - Turn 3” wherein the effect of certain dungeon mechanics caused the Arcanist action “Bane” to affect monsters which originally should not be affected. In order to address this issue, we have changed the aforementioned mechanics.

Please note that this issue did not affect the regular tactics players have been using as they aim to set the world's fastest time to completion, and has no direct effect on those who have already cleared “The Final Coil of Bahamut - Turn 3”.

Additionally, rest assured that the implemented change will not suddenly raise the difficulty of or greatly change the tactics required to clear the dungeon.

We greatly appreciate the input of the players who discovered this issue and the sincerity with which they face the clearing of these challenges.

We hope you continue to enjoy running the Final Coil of Bahamut!

Known Issues With the Lodestone (Nov. 18)
Currently, we have confirmed that the data optimization implemented in patch 2.4 is causing the following issues with the Lodestone.

- Certain Characters’ Achievement Histories Have Been Reset
We have confirmed an issue occurring after patch 2.4 wherein characters who had not completed achievements beyond a fixed period of time have had their achievement history reset.

This issue does not affect the status of any information in-game, but on the Lodestone, information regarding achievement history has been lost. For this reason, at the time the next new achievement is completed, all previous achievements completed up until that point will display simultaneously, as if completed all at once.

Please note, because we have temporarily stopped the Lodestone from updating, players who have not already been affected by this issue do not have to worry about having their achievement history reset. Unfortunately, for players who have already been affected, their achievement history data is lost and cannot be recovered.

- Various Ranking Numbers Are Incorrect
We have confirmed an issue occurring on the Lodestone after patch 2.4 wherein various rankings displayed are incorrect. Investigation and recovery work is underway, and we will update you as soon as there is any new information.

- Free Company Housing Size Information Is Incorrect
We have confirmed an issue occurring on the Lodestone after patch 2.4 wherein all free company housing, regardless of actual size, is labeled as size “S”.

We are currently working on a fix. In the meantime, please note that this issue does not in any way affect the actual housing in-game.

We apologize for any inconvenience, and ask your patience and understanding.

[Important]Software Token Version Update (Nov. 27)
On Dec. 4, 2014, in order to add usability features such as language selection, the iOS/Android app “SQUARE ENIX Software Token” will receive a version update.

Current users of the Software Token app should update via the App Store/Google Play as soon as the version update is available.

If you are unable to perform the version update normally after Dec. 4, you will need your “Emergency Removal Password” to remove the Software Token linked to your account before uninstalling and reinstalling the app.

Locating your Emergency Removal Password:

(1) Log in to the Square Enix Account Management System with your Square Enix ID, password, and One-Time Password.
http://sqex.to/KeD

(2) The Emergency Removal Password can be found on the page after logging in under the section “Token Usage Status”.

Removing the Software Token from your account:

(1) Go the Emergency Removal page and then enter your Square Enix ID, password, and Emergency Removal Password.
https://secure.square-enix.com/account/app/svc/coercioncan

(2) Click the URL located within the automatic email that will be sent to the registered email address.

(3) The Software Token will be removed once the URL is accessed.
* The URL will only be valid for 60 minutes.

After removing the Software Token from your account, please uninstall the app from your device. You will then need to reinstall the app and link it to your account.
http://www.square-enix.com/na/account/otp/token.html

title: News
body:
04/17/2015 3:30 AM
Login Issue (Apr. 17)
Currently, we are receiving contacts from users in certain environments who have become unable to log in to services connected to their Square Enix Account.

Investigation has revealed that the issue stems from application of the latest Windows Update, which turns off the “Use SSL 3.0” setting under Internet Options in Internet Explorer 11.

We ask that users who are experiencing this issue take the following steps to change their Internet Explorer 11 settings.

[Steps]
1. Open Internet Explorer 11
2. Open Internet Options
3. Select the “Advanced” tab
4. Check the boxes next to the following and click “Apply”:
- Use TLS 1.0
- Use TLS 1.1
- Use TLS 1.2

[Affected Services]
- FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn
- The Lodestone
- Mog Station
- FINAL FANTASY XIV Forums
- Square Enix Account Management System

[PlayStation®3][PlayStation®4] Issues with the “FINAL FANTASY XIV: Heavensward (Add-On)” Download (May 18)
We have confirmed an issue with the “FINAL FANTASY XIV: Heavensward (Add-On)” download for the PlayStation®3 and PlayStation®4 systems wherein the downloaded content causes FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn to fail at the version check, resulting in the game not starting.
* This is the data that is downloaded when a customer enters their 12-digit pre-purchase code in the PlayStation® Store.

If you have pre-purchased FINAL FANTASY XIV: Heavensward for either PlayStation®3 or PlayStation®4, please refrain from redeeming the 12-digit pre-purchase code at this time. If you have already done so and have encountered the issue, please completely uninstall FINAL FANTASY XIV from your system, then re-download and re-install FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn only. Please be sure that the Heavensward add-on is not checked when you re-download the game.

The issue is currently being investigated so that a fix can be implemented as soon as possible.

We are sorry for the inconvenience this issue is causing and thank you for your patience.

*May 19, 2015 12:20 AM
It has been confirmed that this issue only affects downloads from the European region PlayStation®Store. Currently in the North America region, product codes cannot yet be registered, and is therefore not affected by this issue.
