title: News
body:
10/24/2022 8:00 PM
Strengthening Enforcement Against Real Money Trading (RMT) Activity
We would like to share an update on efforts we are making to strengthen our enforcement against Real Money Trading (RMT) activity.

As detailed in our weekly “Actions Taken Against In-Game RMT & Other Illicit Activities” announcements, we have always taken a strong stance against RMT activity.

However, given that we continue to observe a certain level of RMT activity in the game each week, we will be increasing staffing, upgrading our tools, and adding new procedures to further strengthen our enforcement and provide our community with a safe and secure gaming experience.

The following is an explanation regarding how RMT activity negatively impacts the game and promotes fraudulent activity.

■ The negative impact of RMT and how it promotes fraudulent activity
The act of selling and buying in-game data (such as items and characters) with real-life currency, or assisting in such activity, is referred to as Real Money Trading (RMT). RMT upsets the balance of the game, and is therefore prohibited under the FINAL FANTASY XIV User Agreement.

We are aware of groups that engage in RMT, which we refer to as “RMT vendors,” whose only goal is to make real-life profit. These vendors do not care about adhering to the User Agreement and will often obstruct the gameplay of normal players to benefit themselves. Furthermore, RMT vendors very commonly engage in real-life criminal activity, such as the unauthorized access of accounts and the use of stolen credit card information.

The majority of items and gil sold through RMT were produced as a result of such fraudulent activity. Purchasing from RMT vendors promotes these fraudulent activities and is prohibited under the FINAL FANTASY XIV User Agreement. Furthermore, as a reminder, doing so also leads to promoting activities deemed illegal in real-life.

We strongly encourage players to refrain from engaging with these groups, as there would be no reason for RMT vendors to exist if players do not use their services.

■ Reporting RMT Activity
Should you witness any RMT activity, we ask that you contact us using the in-game reporting menu, which can be found under [System Menu] -> [Support Desk] -> [Contact Us] -> [Report Cheating].

Additionally, RMT advertisements in chat can be reported by selecting the character’s name in the chat log, opening the subcommand menu and choosing the [Report] -> [Report RMT Activity] option. These reports will be processed automatically, and the reported character will be restricted from sending further messages once they are determined to be advertising RMT activity.

10/25/2022 3:00 AM
Changes to the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store Gifting Feature
The process for gifting optional items on the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store has been updated as of Tuesday, October 25, 2022. This change was implemented as a countermeasure against fraudulent purchases made using the previous version of the gifting feature, as we confirmed instances of gift codes being purchased for the purpose of resale, as well as real-life criminal activity where purchases were potentially made using stolen credit card information.

With the new gifting feature, certain items may be purchased as a gift for friends on your friend list and automatically delivered to them via the moogle delivery service on your behalf.

We anticipate that even with this update, third parties will continue their attempts to sell fraudulently obtained items at lower prices by temporarily registering the buyer on their friend list. However, the new gift service tracks the individual who purchased an item, as well as who it was gifted to. Should we determine a purchase to be fraudulent, the gift may be deleted even if it has already been delivered via the moogle delivery service.

As a reminder, should you accept a gift purchased via fraudulent means, the item(s) may be deleted, and your account may be subject to penalties for taking part in real money trading (RMT).

* Items that can only be used once per character have been excluded from the gifting feature to avoid the possibility of the recipient having already used the item before. Please refer to the Gifts for Friends Guidelines before purchasing items as a gift.

We appreciate your understanding and cooperation as we continue to implement countermeasures against fraudulent activity.

body:

Regarding Data Recovery for Disbandment and Dismissals that occurred with Cross-world Linkshell, PvP team, and Fellowship (Oct. 31)
We would like to share details regarding the data recovery performed in Patch 6.28 for the following issue that was addressed in the Sep. 1, 2022 Hotfixes.

*Please follow the links below for data recovery performed in Patch 6.21,
https://sqex.to/0JpNR

■Issue details
There were cases where the Cross-world Linkshell, PvP team, or fellowship was disbanded if the owner (Cross-world Linkshell/fellowship: Master, PvP team: Team leader) had no more subscription days on their account and their character was withdrawn.

■Data recovery performed on disbanded Cross-world Linkshell

We have performed data recovery for all Cross-world Linkshells that were disbanded due to this issue.

If you have exceeded the maximum number (8) of Cross-world Linkshells you can join due to the data recovery, some of the excess Cross-world Linkshells will not appear in the list, and you will not be able to chat in them. You will receive a message when you log in if there are excess Cross-world Linkshells, and we kindly ask you to leave the unwanted Cross-world Linkshells to adjust them to be under the maximum number. We apologize for the inconvenience caused by this.

1. Leave unwanted Cross-world Linkshells
2. Close the Cross-world Linkshelk window
3. Execute text command “//resetSettingCWLS”
4. Change area or log in again
*Executing the text command will initialize the order of your Cross-world Linkshells. As exceeding the maximum number may cause issues with the order information, we kindly ask you to sort the order again after executing the text command. We apologize for the inconvenience caused by this.

■Data recovery performed on disbanded fellowships

We have performed data recovery for all fellowships that were disbanded due to this issue.

If you have exceeded the maximum number (10) of fellowships you can join due to the data recovery, some of the excess fellowships will not appear in the list. You will receive a message when you log in if there are excess fellowships, and we kindly ask you to leave the unwanted fellowships to adjust them to be under the maximum number. We apologize for the inconvenience caused by this.

■Data recovery performed on characters that were dismissed from their fellowship

As of Patch 6.21, we have recovered followships up to the maximum number (10) in advance, and in Patch 6.28, we have also restored characters with more than 10 fellowships.

If you have exceeded the maximum number (10) of fellowships you can join due to the data recovery, some of the excess fellowships will not appear in the list. You will receive a message when you log in if there are excess fellowships, and we kindly ask you to leave the unwanted fellowships to adjust them to be under the maximum number. We apologize for the inconvenience caused by this.

■Data recovery for other cases

We will continue to carefully consider recovery process for the following case given it is a community group players may only join one at a time, and the complexity of the recovery process.

・PvP teams that were disbanded

We will announce the schedule for this as soon as it is confirmed. We kindly ask for your patience while we work on this.

Once again, we deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused by this issue and thank you for your understanding.

Microsoft will no longer provide security updates or support for PCs running Windows® 8.1 after January 10, 2023, so we have found that continuing support for this operating system is a difficult proposition.

You will likely be able to play FINAL FANTASY XIV on Windows® 8.1 systems even after the end of support. However, after we discontinue support, we will as a general rule no longer be able to provide support for problems arising as a result of the operating system.

Square Enix may respond to requests for technical support regarding Windows® 8.1 issues after the end of support, but such informal support will be limited, on a case-by-case basis, and is not guaranteed.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

title: News
body:
01/13/2023 1:50 PM
Known Issues After Patch 6.3 (Jan. 13)
The following issues have been confirmed.
We are currently investigating and working to address these issues.

[Current Known Issues]

■ Under certain conditions, targeting actions with conal or linear area attacks are initiated in the direction in which the character is facing while also hitting the selected target.

* To clarify, this issue does not initiate two separate area attacks; rather, an area attack is initiated in the direction the character is facing while also hitting the selected target regardless of its position to the character.

Our investigation thus far has revealed that the issue is related to a fundamental system process related to targeting and actions and has existed since Patch 4.2, though the timing at which this process has taken effect has varied depending on the content. Resolving this issue will require modifications to the fundamental process in addition to detailed adjustments for affected actions, which will require an extended period to address.

However, we will be prioritizing addressing PvP and Limit Break actions, which are believed to be particularly affected, as soon as possible; we will then address other affected aspects in order.

▼ Patch 6.31
・ PvP Actions
Frontal area attacks will initiate and deal damage in the direction of the selected target even when under the aforementioned conditions.

・ Limit Break
Under certain conditions, area attacks will still initiate in the direction in which the character is facing; however, tentative measures will be taken to prevent attacks from hitting targets outside of the initiated direction.

▼ Patch 6.4 Onwards
In addition to adjusting internal processes, a standardized behavior will be implemented to ensure that all affected actions will behave correctly even when under the aforementioned conditions.

* A notice regarding the timing of this implementation will be announced at a later date once preparations are complete

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience as we work to address this issue. Please be mindful and refrain from attempting to utilize this issue intentionally.

■ Certain animals may not appear in Island Sanctuary even when the required conditions are fulfilled.

* Prior to Patch 6.3, we had confirmed that this issue occurred for characters who had exited the Island Sanctuary during the period the animals were spawning after the conditions were met. As characters affected by this issue are unable to encounter these certain animals until the fix is implemented, we are working quickly to investigate and address the issue. We apologize for the inconvenience caused to those experiencing this issue and appreciate your patience as we work to address this issue.

*Edited on Jan. 24, 2023 4:00 a.m. (PST)
The issue above was fixed during the maintenance that took place from Jan. 23, 2023 10:00 p.m. to Jan. 24, 2023 2:00 a.m. (PST)
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

■ In Alphascape V4.0 (Savage), action-related indicators are not displayed for the boss actions Diffuse Wave Cannon and Oversampled Wave Cannon.

*Edited on Jan. 24, 2023 4:00 a.m. (PST)
The issue above was fixed during the maintenance that took place from Jan. 23, 2023 10:00 p.m. to Jan. 24, 2023 2:00 a.m. (PST)
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused by this issue.

[Important]Important Notice About Purchases and Subscriptions
In late March, we are planning to change the payment processor used for purchases made on the FINAL FANTASY XIV: Mog Station, FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store, and Square Enix Account Management sites. This change should not have an impact on most purchases, but we wanted to inform and clearly communicate to customers of any potential changes.

The change should not impact customers who are currently enrolled in a recurring subscription plan. However, future updates to an existing recurring subscription, such as starting a new recurring subscription or making updates to the payment method on existing recurring subscriptions, will be processed through the new payment processor. Switching an existing recurring subscription plan to the new payment processor will require the re-registration of their payment method. Although the current payment processor will continue to be available for a period following the change, we recommend updating an active recurring subscription after the change occurs as this will help prevent any account access disruptions in the event that the current payment processor is no longer available.

Furthermore, some of the existing payment methods will no longer be available following the change. While we hope to reintroduce some of the discontinued payment methods over time, we recommend considering alternate payment methods in the meantime. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Please see below for affected payment methods.

Unavailable Payment Methods: Discover, JCB, Carte Bleue, SEPA (Sofort)
Available Payment Methods: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Amazon Pay, Paysafecard

Additionally, customers may notice other minor differences following the change: the manner in which credit card charges show up on billing statements may be slightly different, or banks may request fraud verification on purchases that used to be approved without such additional steps. While the changes should not impact purchases, we do recommend our customers to review any charges made after the change for due diligence purposes, and to ensure any charges are for purchases made from Square Enix.

It is possible that with the change in payment processor, transactions that previously had no issues are now declined. In such cases, please contact the Square Enix Support Center (https://sqex.to/s5G9O) so we may look into and resolve the matter with you.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the changes described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center (https://sqex.to/s5G9O).

[Important]Temporary Suspension of Automatic Housing Demolition
From all of us on the FFXIV development and management team, our hearts go out to those who were affected by the massive earthquake that occurred in southeastern Turkey on Monday, February 6.

Due to the damages and other factors, we have decided to temporarily suspend the automatic demolition of estates.

Date and Time Auto-Demolition Counter Will be Suspended:
Feb. 9, 2023 9:25 a.m. (PST)

Worlds in Which Auto-Demolition Will Be Suspended: All Chaos/Light Data Center Worlds

* After the above date and time, the counter will stop completely.
* If your estate or land is currently being prepared for auto-demolition, you can cancel this status by entering your estate or constructing an estate on your land.
* When the Auto-Demolition Counter resumes it will resume from the time remaining as of the temporary suspension. (Excludes estates/lands where the demolition process has been canceled.)

As for when auto-demolition will resume, we will monitor the situation in the coming days, and inform you all when we have come to a decision that auto-demolition can commence again.

It is our sincere hope that recovery is swift, and those of you who were affected will be able to rejoin us in Eorzea soon.

Known Issues After Patch 6.4 (May 23)
The following issues has been confirmed.
We are currently investigating and working to address these issues.

【Current Known Issues】

■Sound will not play under certain conditions. (Windows® version only)

*We are prioritizing the investigation of this issue, and while it is possible that the issue may be caused by a temporary gamepad disconnection, we have not yet identified a definite cause at this time.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and for any users who encounter this issue, the symptoms will not be resolved until the client is restarted. Please attempt the following and then restart the client.

・If you are using a gamepad that is recognized as a sound device such as "DUALSHOCK 4" or "DualSense", please try and disable the corresponding sound device from the sound settings of your computer.

If the above does not resolve the issue, please also try the following:

・Remove your gamepad and see if it resolves.
・Check to see if there are any device-related problems with your computer.

In addition, if you experience this issue, please kindly report it to the "In-Game Bugs" section within the official forums and include information about your computer specs and what gamepad is being used. We greatly appreciate your cooperation.

*Edited on June 5, 2023 5:35 a.m. (PDT)
The issue above was fixed during the maintenance that took place from Jun. 5, 2023 11:00 p.m. to Jun. 6, 2023 2:20 a.m. (PDT).

05/25/2023 3:55 AM
[Follow-up]Issue with Sound Not Playing Under Certain Conditions on the Windows® version (May 25)
We would like to report on the current status of our investigation and response regarding the issue preventing sound from playing under certain conditions on the Windows® version.

■Details and Cause of this Issue

In our investigation, we have determined that the issue is caused when the sound device is not being recognized by the computer, and the sound reset process in the game client is executed. This causes the processing of sound to freeze, as a result, the sounds stop playing and the game client cannot be closed properly when trying to exit.

Issues due to this process have been present since Patch 6.0 and have been working without significant impact until now, but there is a high possibility that a different internal process that was changed in Patch 6.4 has triggered this issue.

Depending on the combination of devices, PC usage, and other differences in the environment, the issue may or may not occur in some cases, making it difficult to investigate and identify the cause. However, thanks to the numerous reports we received from the players, we were able to isolate the problem and identify the cause. Thank you very much for your cooperation.

■Prospects for Resolving this Issue

We will continue to prioritize the resolution of this issue, but since it is a core component of sound processing, the following measures will be necessary, and it is expected to take up to two weeks to address this issue.

・Predict possible device combinations in PC environments
・Pattern verification of several PC environments
・Verification of the completion of the fixes in these combinations

We are aware that some players are refraining from progressing through the main scenario until the issue is addressed, and we apologize for the inconvenience this may cause. However, we are striving to resolve this issue as quickly as possible and kindly ask for your patience until then.

■Temporary Workaround

Please attempt to use the following previously reported method which depending on the environment, may temporarily allow you to circumvent the issue.

・If you are using a gamepad that is recognized as a sound device such as "DUALSHOCK 4" or "DualSense", please try and disable the corresponding sound device from the sound settings of your computer and restart the client.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

*Edited on June 5, 2023 5:35 a.m. (PDT)
The issue above was fixed during the maintenance that took place from Jun. 5, 2023 11:00 p.m. to Jun. 6, 2023 2:20 a.m. (PDT).
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

We have received several reports that the monsters in Thavnair, which are necessary to complete the quest, are easily being KO'd in the "By Agents Unknown" side quest, making it difficult to progress through the quest.

We determined that the fastest and most feasible way to deal with this issue is to increase the number of target monsters, and to divide "Thavnair" into field instances. "Thavnair" has consequently been divided into field instances on all worlds at 5:35 a.m. on July 18, 2023.

You can move to any instance by moving the area as usual or by accessing aetheryte and specifying the instance number, and we hope you will be able to use any available instance. In addition, you can check the current field instance area name by using the text command "/instance".

We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.

07/24/2023 3:10 AM
Fan Festival Bonus Item Delivery
We are expecting some delays in the delivery of in-game items for bonus item codes and optional item purchases after FINAL FANTASY XIV Fan Festival 2023–2024 items are made available for purchase.
Please take the following into consideration before purchasing any optional items.

【Make enough free space to receive your Mog Letters】
Please make sure you have enough free space to receive items before making a purchase by taking items from any letters you have received in the "Purchases & Rewards" tab and deleting the letters afterwards.
*Please note that if you have purchased multiple items, they will be sent to you in separate letters. Please make sure that you have freed up enough space.

You can only receive a total of 20 Mog Letters related to bonus items, optional items, or gift items. If you do not have enough free space, the system will attempt to redeliver the items at another time. The time taken between each attempt to redeliver optional items may be extended in order to reduce the server load this process has on the general delivery system.

◆Delivery timing of optional items
The delivery time of optional items varies depending on the type of purchase.

・Items purchased for single characters
→ Items will be delivered immediately after purchase
・Account-wide item purchases
→ Log in with a character after purchase to have the item delivered to that character

With account-wide item purchases, you must log in with the character after making the purchase in order to receive the item. Please be sure to log out and then log back in again if the purchase was made whilst logged in to FINAL FANTASY XIV.
Please note that if you purchased both types of optional items, the items may be delivered at different times due to the nature of the delivery system.

【Checking the status of the optional item purchases】
You can check the status on the Mog Station via "Payment History".

Please note item deliveries may be delayed during peak times. If you have still not received your items despite confirming all of the above points, please be advised that it can take up to 24 hours before items are delivered. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and thank you for your understanding.

[Important]Important Notice about Software Tokens and Software Authenticators (Sep. 18)
This is a notice to all customers who use a Software Token or Software Authenticator.

If you are using a Software Token or Software Authenticator (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, etc.) on your smartphone and decide to switch to a new phone or delete the app, you will need to use an Emergency Removal Password to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator from the old device, after which you must re-register the app to your new device. If you are planning on switching phones or deleting the application, please be sure you have your Emergency Removal Password at hand first.

*In the case you cannot perform an emergency removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator, you will no longer be able to log in to or use the various services related to your applicable Square Enix account.

How to confirm your Emergency Removal Password

(1) Log in to the Square Enix Account Management System.

Square Enix Account Management System:
https://sqex.to/fHa

(2) After you have logged into the Square Enix Account Management System, your Emergency Removal Password will be displayed under “Token Usage Status” below the “Square Enix Account Information” section.

*The Emergency Removal Password is a one-time password that changes after each use. After you have used it, you must log into the Square Enix Account Management System again to obtain your new one-time Emergency Removal Password.

Before you switch phones or delete the application, please be sure to follow the above steps to confirm and store your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. After you have switched phones or deleted your application, this password will be necessary to perform the Emergency Removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator registered to your old device.

How to perform an emergency removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator

(1) Go to the Software Token/Software Authenticator Emergency Removal page and enter your Square Enix ID and password and your Emergency Removal Password.

Software Token Emergency Removal page:
https://sqex.to/GPE

(2) An email containing the Software Token/Software Authenticator removal URL will be sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account.

(3) Click on the URL to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator
* Note that the URL will expire after 60 minutes. Please be sure to click on it and complete the removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator before it expires.

How to Re-register your Software Token/Software Authenticator

Please visit the links below for step-by-step instructions on re-registering your app.
[Software Token] https://sqex.to/TPSj1
[Software Authenticator] https://sqex.to/2HJDL

If you have lost your Emergency Removal Password or are unable to perform the emergency removal of the Software Token yourself, the Support Center will be able to remove it for you once account ownership is verified. Please review the FAQ below for further details.

How do I remove the Square Enix Security Token from my account?
https://sqex.to/mVZ

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the steps described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center.

Square Enix Support Center
https://sqex.to/s5G9O

We would like to report on the current status of the following issue.

title: News
body:
01/04/2024 5:30 AM
[Important]Temporary Suspension of Automatic Housing Demolition
From all of us on the FFXIV development and management team, our hearts go out to those who were affected by the massive earthquake that occurred in Noto Peninsula on January 1st, Monday.

Due to the damages and other factors, we have decided to temporarily suspend the automatic demolition of estates.

Date and Time Auto-Demolition Counter Will be Suspended:
Thursday, January 4th, 2024, 3:23 a.m. (PST)

Worlds in Which Auto-Demolition Will Be Suspended: All the worlds under Elemental Data Center/Gaia Data Center/Mana Data Center/Meteor Data Center

* After the above date and time, the counter will stop completely.
* If your estate or land is currently being prepared for auto-demolition, you can cancel this status by entering your estate or constructing an estate on your land.
* When the Auto-Demolition Counter resumes it will resume from the time remaining as of the temporary suspension. (Excludes estates/lands where the demolition process has been canceled.)

As for when auto-demolition will resume, we will monitor the situation in the coming days, and inform you all when we have come to a decision that auto-demolition can commence again.

It is our sincere hope that recovery is swift, and those of you who were affected will be able to rejoin us in FFXIV soon.

body:
02/02/2024 6:20 AM
Regarding the End of Windows® 32-bit OS and DirectX 9 Support (Feb. 2)
Thank you for your continued support of FINAL FANTASY XIV.

As previously announced in 2019, Windows® 32bitOS and DirectX 9 applications are no longer supported by FINAL FANTASY XIV, but it has still been possible to run and play the game on them.

However, with the graphics update scheduled in Patch 7.0, DirectX 9 applications will be disabled. In anticipation of this, we will discontinue the use of DirectX 9 applications with the release of Patch 6.58 scheduled in March.

After Patch 6.58, you will no longer be able to continue playing FINAL FANTASY XIV using Windows® 32bitOS and DirectX 9 applications. If you wish to continue playing FINAL FANTASY XIV on your current system, please consider updating to the latest OS version before the release of Patch 6.58.

[Important]Important Update About Purchases and Subscriptions (Apr. 5)
The change to the payment processor used for purchases on the FINAL FANTASY XIV: Mog Station, FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store and Square Enix Account Management sites is scheduled to be implemented on April 23, 2024. This should not have an impact on most purchases, but we want to share some information to help make the transition as smooth as possible.

After April 23, 2024, we will be confirming the address for the account for payment security purposes. You can confirm and update your registered address by logging into the Square Enix Account Management System and accessing the “Account Information” section from the "Account" menu.

This change should not have an impact on customers who have a recurring subscription. However, customer payments will begin using the new payment processor as soon as any change is made to an existing subscription plan, such as changing the payment method, or setting up a new recurring subscription. We recommend making changes to your account after April 24, 2024 to prevent any disruption.

Please note that some payment methods that are currently offered will not be available after the transition. While we are planning to add more payment methods in the future, for now you will need to choose from the available payment methods:

Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Amazon Pay, and Paysafecard

Unfortunately, we will not be able to accept JCB, Carte Bleue, SEPA (ELV). We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

We recommend due diligence when reviewing charges after the change to ensure they are from Square Enix for purchases you made. You may notice that credit card charges appear differently on your bank statement, or your bank may request additional fraud verification for new purchases.

In cases where a transaction is declined, you encounter error messages, or you have any other difficulties with payments, please contact the Square Enix Support Center (https://sqex.to/s5G9O) so we can assist you.

[Important][NA] Upcoming Changes to FINAL FANTASY XIV Payments
Thank you for your continued support of FINAL FANTASY XIV.
We have an announcement regarding upcoming changes related to game subscriptions, as well as all purchases made from the Mog Station and the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store.

Beginning June 25, 2024, all customer transactions on the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store and Mog Station, including game subscriptions, will be subject to any state or local sales tax, where applicable. Any purchases made following the introduction of these changes will be adjusted to include estimated sales tax based on the address registered on the Square Enix account from which the purchase is made.

Please note that this change will also apply to recurring subscriptions paid by credit card or Crysta to your service account, and any subscription charges processed following the introduction of these changes will also be subject to applicable sales tax.

To avoid incorrect charges, please ensure that the address registered to your Square Enix account is correct. You can confirm and update your registered address by logging into the Square Enix Account Management System (https://secure.square-enix.com/) and accessing the "Account Information" section from the "Account" menu.

Additional details regarding these updates will be provided in future notices.

Following our investigation into the inability to use Visa Debit cards after the payment processor switch in April 2024, we are pleased to announce that we will be implementing adjustments which will once again enable Visa Debit as a payment option for customers in North America.
The adjustments are currently targeted for release in July 2024, and we will provide a more specific date as we move closer to implementation.

In the meantime, we would like to take this opportunity to remind customers that other payment options are available, such as Crysta (which can be purchased via Amazon Pay or PayPal), Amazon Pay (for online store purchases), or game time codes available from various online retailers, including the Square Enix Store.

[Important]Be Wary of Phishing Attempts via In-game Messages
As we have mentioned in the past, we have confirmed that certain individuals are attempting to direct players to fake login websites imitating the Square Enix Account Management System or FINAL FANTASY XIV-related websites in an effort to steal (also known as “phishing”) information such as Square Enix Account ID and password, as well as date of birth.

The following are some recent examples of Tell messages which direct random players to scamming websites by pretending to invite them to a campaign on the official forums.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Example 1:
300M raffle giveaway starting in 15mins, post a number 1-30 on the FFXIV forum thread to enter: https://■■.square-enix■■.com.■■/ffxiv/forums/

Example 2:
Next mount update https://■■.square-enix■■.com.■■/ffxiv/forums/

Example 3:
2 free mounts https://■■.square-enix■■.com.■■/ffxiv/forums/

The fake URL is pretending to link to the official forum, but has an unusual string of characters in the ■. The URL for our official forums is [https://forum.square-enix.com/ffxiv/].

Example 4:
300M raffle giveaway starting in 15mins: twitch.tv/■■■■■
Some phishing methods direct users to external websites such as Twitch, then redirect them to a fake forum link from there.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

We have confirmed that even accounts using one-time passwords are susceptible to these scams. Since these fake websites require you to enter your one-time password as well, this allows scammers to gain access to your Square Enix account, password, and one-time password. Although one-time passwords are meant to be used only once, entering a one-time password into a fake website merely exposes it to the scammers and does not count as having been used. Scammers can then use the stolen one-time password to log in to your account.

The examples above are just some of the characteristics of scams we have confirmed. However, it is highly likely that scammers will continuously change their phishing methods. Whenever a website asks for your account information, please exercise caution and verify that you are not entering sensitive account information into a fake website.

Please review the following “Be Wary of Suspicious URLs and Websites” page for additional information:
https://sqex.to/zraqE

* Please review the following "Warning Concerning the Security of Your Account" page below:
https://sqex.to/kWj2b

In order to protect your data and personal information, we urge everyone to be cautious when handling account information such as their Square Enix ID and password.

[Important]Helpful Support Articles for Dawntrail Early Access and Launch
In anticipation of the early access and launch of Dawntrail, we would like to share a list of support articles which new or returning players may find helpful in resolving account-related inquiries.

Make sure to purchase the correct version of Dawntrail
・Confirm which version of the game you have registered by logging into the Mog Station and visiting the Service Account Status section: https://sqex.to/tjGxz

General Tips for Returning Players

Login Information

・What is a Security Token?
A One-Time Password Token is a device/application for displaying One-Time Passwords that will dramatically improve account security when used. If you do not have a One-Time Password Token registered, please leave this field blank when attempting to log into an account.

For security purposes, accounts that have been inactive for an extended period may be placed on a login restriction and will require a password update.

We recommend logging into your account ahead of early access and launch to verify if there are any login restrictions in place.
・I cannot log in to my account: https://sqex.to/sZjMf
・How does the login restriction work?: https://sqex.to/JsgTS

If you have any issues that you are unable to resolve using the tips above, our support team is more than ready to help! Please visit the FINAL FANTASY XIV Support Center, which offers several methods of contacting us including chat, email, and phone. Please note that the options to contact us through chat or phone are only available Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. (PDT) and excludes holidays.

Regarding Server Congestion Status (Jun. 28)
Thank you for playing FINAL FANTASY XIV: Dawntrail.

Since the start of early access on Friday, June 28, 2024, we have been experiencing extraordinary player counts, but the logins have been exceptionally smooth thus far due to our data center expansions, additional Worlds, and improvements to server performance.

However, we are noticing concentrated logins on certain Worlds which are beginning to reach their login capacity, particularly the Worlds on the Aether Data Center (North American DC) and the Phoenix World on the Light Data Center (European DC).

The login queues are stable, and although they may appear to be moving slowly or the countdown numbers may not seem to be progressing, we have confirmed the queue is steadily moving forward as intended. Should you run into a long login queue, please consider logging into a relatively less congested World via Data Center Travel or the World Visit System.

As we recently announced, congestion measures are temporarily in place for Data Center Travel and the World Visit System. Please refer to the following announcement for further details regarding these temporary measures.

■ Regarding Congestion During Dawntrail's Launch
https://sqex.to/WOHko

We will continue monitoring the situation in hopes that FINAL FANTASY XIV will continue to be enjoyed by as many players as possible. We apologize for the inconvenience in the meantime and appreciate your patience regarding the congestion situation.

Thank you for your cooperation in easing congestion since the start of Dawntrail early access.

Worlds in Which Auto-Demolition Will Be Suspended:
All Worlds
(Regarding the JP data center, it is previously already suspended there for a different reason we have already notified you about.)

* After the above date and time, the counter will stop completely.
* If your estate or land is currently being prepared for auto-demolition, you can cancel this status by entering your estate or constructing an estate on your land.
* When the Auto-Demolition Counter resumes it will resume from the time remaining as of the temporary suspension. (Excludes estates/lands where the demolition process has been canceled.)

As for when auto-demolition will resume, we will monitor the situation in the coming days, and inform you all when we have come to a decision that auto-demolition can commence again.

Compensation for Companion App Issue (Jul. 30)
During the maintenance conducted from July 29, 2024 at 11:00 p.m. to July 30, 2024 at 2:00 a.m. (PDT), compensation was provided for an issue that occurred with the Companion app during the following period.

■Issue Period
June 28, 2024 at 4:00 a.m. to July 5, 2024 at 5:00 a.m. (PDT)

■Issue Details
・An issue with retainer ventures wherein under certain conditions, retainers could be assigned to ventures which they did not meet the item level requirement for.
・An issue with retainer ventures wherein under certain conditions, more items were procured than usual.

■Compensation Eligibility and Details
▽Eligible Users
Users who assigned a retainer venture through the Companion app and received fewer items than the amount initially displayed in the venture assignment menu.

* Compensation was provided for the following cases.
・ Users who assigned a procurement venture through the Companion app during the issue period and received the items in-game.
・Users who assigned a procurement venture through the Companion app during the issue period and received the items via the app after the issue was resolved.

▽Compensation Details
The Kupo Nuts or Mog Coins that were consumed when assigning procurement ventures will be compensated with Mog Coins (free coins).

* The compensated Mog Coins will be displayed as “Compensatory Mog Coins” in the Companion app menu under Account > History > Gained.

If you believe that you are eligible but have not been compensated, please contact the FINAL FANTASY XIV Support Center with the following information.

■Required Information:
・Character Name
・Home World
・Retainer Name
・Name of the item received from the retainer venture (If you do not remember, please state Unknown)
・Date and time of the retainer venture (If you do not remember, please state Unknown)

FINAL FANTASY XIV Support Center
https://sqex.to/WXr

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

title: News
body:
09/06/2024 1:00 AM
Known Issues with some Summoner/Scholar Traits (Sep. 6)
We have identified the issues below with the Summoner's "Arcane Mastery" trait and the Scholar's "Enhanced Healing Magic" trait.

■Summoner Trait "Arcane Mastery"
Raised potency not activating for the following abilities:
・Inferno
・Earthen Fury
・Aerial Blast

■Scholar Trait "Enhanced Healing Magic"
Raised potency for healing and shielding effect not activating for the following abilities:
・Embrace
・Seraphic Veil

After investigation, we confirmed that due to this issue, incorrect values were being used in battle balance adjustment in the dev environment for the jobs in question, since potency and healing/shielding effects were not being enhanced for these abilities.

However, since the issue is not having any direct impact to battle balance as it is now with its current values, it will instead be fixed in tandem with job adjustments in Patch 7.1.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

*Updated Nov. 15, 2024 4:15 a.m. (PST)
This issue was addressed by the maintenance of Nov. 11, 2024 7:00 p.m. to Nov. 12, 2024 1:20 a.m. (PST).
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

title: News
body:
09/17/2024 10:00 PM
[Important]Important Notice about Software Tokens and Software Authenticators (Sep. 17)
This is a notice to all customers who use a Software Token or Software Authenticator.

If you are using a Software Token or Software Authenticator (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, etc.) on your smartphone and decide to switch to a new phone or delete the app, you will need to use an Emergency Removal Password to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator from the old device, after which you must re-register the app to your new device. If you are planning on switching phones or deleting the application, please be sure you have your Emergency Removal Password at hand first.

*In the case you cannot perform an emergency removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator, you will no longer be able to log in to or use the various services related to your applicable Square Enix account.
*New registrations for Software Tokens have closed as of November 21, 2023, so please use Software Authenticator Apps or Square Enix Security Tokens (Key Ring Type) after performing the Emergency Removal.

How to confirm your Emergency Removal Password

(1) Log in to the Square Enix Account Management System.

Square Enix Account Management System:
https://sqex.to/fHa

(2) After you have logged into the Square Enix Account Management System, your Emergency Removal Password will be displayed under “Token Usage Status” below the “Square Enix Account Information” section.

*The Emergency Removal Password is a one-time password that changes after each use. After you have used it, you must log into the Square Enix Account Management System again to obtain your new one-time Emergency Removal Password.

Before you switch phones or delete the application, please be sure to follow the above steps to confirm and store your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. After you have switched phones or deleted your application, this password will be necessary to perform the Emergency Removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator registered to your old device.

How to perform an emergency removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator

(1) Go to the Software Token/Software Authenticator Emergency Removal page and enter your Square Enix ID and password and your Emergency Removal Password.

Software Token Emergency Removal page:
https://sqex.to/GPE

(2) An email containing the Software Token/Software Authenticator removal URL will be sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account.

(3) Click on the URL to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator
* Note that the URL will expire after 60 minutes. Please be sure to click on it and complete the removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator before it expires.

How to Re-register your Software Token/Software Authenticator

Please visit the links below for step-by-step instructions on re-registering your app and purchasing a Square Enix Security Token.
*New registrations for Software Tokens have closed as of November 21, 2023, so they may no longer be used after an Emergency Removal.
Please use Software Authenticator Apps or Square Enix Security Tokens (Key Ring Type).

[Software Authenticator] https://sqex.to/2HJDL
[Purchase Square Enix Security Tokens (Key Ring Type)] https://sqex.to/451zR

If you have lost your Emergency Removal Password or are unable to perform the emergency removal of the Software Token or Software Authenticator yourself, the Support Center will be able to remove it for you once account ownership is verified. Please review the FAQ below for further details.

How do I remove the Square Enix Security Token from my account?
https://sqex.to/mVZ

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the steps described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center.

Square Enix Support Center
https://sqex.to/s5G9O

[Important]Temporary Suspension of Automatic Housing Demolition
From all of us on the FFXIV development and management team, our hearts go out to those who were affected late last month by Hurricane Helene in North America.

Due to the damages and other factors, we have decided to temporarily suspend the automatic demolition of estates.

[Follow-up]Known Issues Following the Release of Patch 7.1 (Nov. 12): Follow-Up
We currently have an update regarding the following water related issues that were brought to our attention:

-Inability to fish in Eastern Thanalan.
-Character's walking animation above water not being properly displayed in Eastern Thanalan.

From our investigation in Patch 7.1, we were able to confirm that when the graphics data for the water surface area of East Thanalan was modified, the collision detection was not properly calibrated. As a result of this, any actions related to water (fishing, walking etc.) will not be processed correctly.

As this issue involves re-modification of the graphics data, this will be fixed in Patch 7.11

We apologize for the inconvenience this has caused and appreciate your patience.

title: News
body:
11/15/2024 2:00 AM
Regarding DUALSHOCK®4 Use on the Windows® Version via Bluetooth® Connection (Nov. 15)
We have received multiple reports that when using a DUALSHOCK®4 connected via Bluetooth® on a Windows® PC, the game pad is recognized by the PC but not by the FINAL FANTASY XIV client.

Through our investigation we have confirmed that when the fix was implemented for a processing issue related to the DualSense™ wireless controller in Patch 7.1, the processing for the DUALSHOCK®4 was adjusted based on the prerequisite that it would be connected properly, and as a result the wireless connection for the DUALSHOCK®4 became unstable in certain environments.

■Regarding the use of a DUALSHOCK®4 wireless connection
As announced in the patch notes for Patch 6.0, when using a DUALSHOCK®4 through a wireless connection, various functions can only be used when connected via the “Wireless Adapter CUH-ZWA1x (the “x” will differ depending on the region it is sold) (Hereafter referred to as specified wireless adapter)”.

However, as a result of the handling in Patch 7.1, issues occurred where things that had previously worked ceased working, and as we were unable to notify players in advance, in Patch 7.11 we will adjust the relevant processing so that DUALSHOCK®4 Bluetooth® connections that do not go through the specified wireless adapter will be recognized as general-purpose input devices.

This may allow the use of the controller in the same environment as before Patch 7.1, but we kindly ask for your understanding that this is not an official connection procedure.

In addition, please try to use the specified wireless adapter as much as possible when connecting, or as sales and support for the DUALSHOCK®4 is ending, we would appreciate it if you could consider using another game pad.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused, and we thank you for your understanding.

*Updated Nov. 26, 2024 4:58 a.m. (PST)
This issue was addressed by the maintenance of Nov. 25, 2024 7:00 p.m. to Nov. 26, 2024 2:00 a.m. (PST).
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

[Important]Temporary Suspension of Automatic Housing Demolition
From all of us on the FFXIV development and management team, our hearts go out to those who were affected by the mountain fires that occurred around Los Angeles in North America.

Due to the damages and other factors, we have decided to temporarily suspend the automatic demolition of estates.

Date and Time Auto-Demolition Counter Will be Suspended:
Thursday, Jan. 9, 2025 8:20 p.m. (PST)

Worlds in Which Auto-Demolition Will Be Suspended: All the worlds under Aether Data Center/Crystal Data Center/Dynamis Data Center/Primal Data Center

* After the above date and time, the counter will stop completely.
* If your estate or land is currently being prepared for auto-demolition, you can cancel this status by entering your estate or constructing an estate on your land.
* When the Auto-Demolition Counter resumes it will resume from the time remaining as of the temporary suspension. (Excludes estates/lands where the demolition process has been canceled.)

As for when auto-demolition will resume, we will monitor the situation in the coming days, and inform you all when we have come to a decision that auto-demolition can commence again.

It is our sincere hope that recovery is swift, and those of you who were affected will be able to rejoin us in FFXIV soon.

title: News
body:
02/06/2025 7:41 PM
[Important]Purchasing FINAL FANTASY XIV Game Time Cards/Codes
We have recently identified a significant increase in the redemption of FINAL FANTASY XIV 60-day Game Time Cards/Codes (GTCs), which have been obtained fraudulently.

Many of these GTCs have been illegally obtained from official retailers, typically using stolen credit cards or other compromised data, and are then sold at a discount on third-party sites. Until now, when we determined that a GTC was obtained fraudulently we would invalidate it before it could be used. However, if the GTC was already redeemed, we would give the benefit of the doubt that the user did not know it was fraudulently obtained and would not penalize the account.

While the fraudulent transaction may not have been made by the person who redeemed the code, purchasing codes from unlicensed sites indirectly supports these illegal activities. To reduce these illegal transactions, we will begin suspending accounts that have redeemed a fraudulently obtained GTC.

If you believe your account has been suspended due to the redemption of a GTC, please contact the Support Center (https://sqex.to/FFXIVsupport) to regain access to the account. As part of regaining account access, the redeemer of the fraudulently obtained GTC will need to pay Square Enix the retail value of the GTC.

To ensure that you purchase legitimate GTCs, we recommend only buying from your local game retailer or official online retailers.

Retailers selling GTCs for American FFXIV accounts:
- Square Enix Store (Americas)
- Amazon
- Newegg
- Gamestop

Retailers selling GTCs for European FFXIV accounts:
- Square Enix Store (Europe)
- Amazon

We appreciate your assistance and understanding as we work to counter fraudulent activities.

Regarding Issues with the Windows® Launcher (Apr. 22)
We have received inquiries about the following errors occurring on the Windows® version of the launcher.

・When starting the launcher, the message “Failed to initialize browser” is displayed and the launcher cannot be started.
・After starting the launcher, the message “An error has occurred. Please try again later.” appears in the Square Enix ID and password entry fields, preventing access to the game.

This symptom appears to occur when "Microsoft Edge" or "Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime" is corrupted. If this symptom occurs, please try repairing "Microsoft Edge" or "Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime".

■How to Repair
・Windows®11
Open “Settings” → “Apps” → “Installed apps,” then select “...” icon for the relevant app and choose “Repair” (or select “Modify” and then “Repair”).

・Windows®10
Open “Settings” → “Apps” → “Apps & features,” then select “Repair” (or select “Change” and then “Repair”) from the “Advanced options” menu for the relevant app.

04/22/2025 7:00 AM
[Follow-up]Regarding Issues with the Windows® Launcher Display (Apr. 22): Follow-up
Since the release of Patch 7.21, we have confirmed that the text and images on the Windows® version launcher are either enlarged or shrunk and are not being displayed properly. We are sharing the current situation as we have confirmed that it affects other things in addition to the Windows® text size settings.

We have determined from our investigation that it is being affected by the Windows® text size settings due to the changes in the launcher rendering system in Patch 7.21.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, but if you are unable to log in due to the Square Enix ID or password input fields not being displayed, we kindly ask that you temporarily adjust the following Windows® settings to the extent possible.

■Regarding the Windows® text size
It might be affected when the text size on Windows® is not set at 100%. We kindly ask that you temporarily adjust the text settings to 100% to the extent possible.

■Windows® accessibility settings
“Settings” → “Accessibility” → “Text size”
*Please note that these settings will affect all text sizes on your PC.

■Regarding the settings when using high DPI displays
It might be affected depending on the settings of high DPI scaling and resolution. We kindly ask that you temporarily change the high DPI scaling settings as follows.

1. Right-click ffxivboot.exe and select properties.
2. Open the setting screen from "Compatibility tab" → "Change high DPI settings "
3. Tick the "Override high DPI scaling behavior" on "High DPI scaling override", and change "Scaling performed by:" to "System (Enhanced)".

We are continuing to investigate and address the issue and kindly ask for your patience. Additional information will follow as the situation develops.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

*Updated Apr. 28, 2025 2:55 a.m. (PDT)
The issue above was addressed by the update of FINAL FANTASY XIV Launcher on Apr. 28, 2025 0:58 a.m. (PDT).
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

body:
04/24/2025 12:40 AM
Regarding Cosmic Exploration Issues and Frequently Received Inquiries (Apr. 23)
We would like to inform you regarding the confirmed issues related to Cosmic Exploration as well as frequently inquired topics.

■Known Issues
・For stellar missions in which aetherial reduction is carried out, the automatic aetherial reduction window may fail to close if the stellar mission objective is completed while the reduction is in progress.
*If this issue occurs, performing a stellar return will make it possible to close the window.
・During Cosmic Exploration, the time between the issuance of a mech op directive and the start of the operation would be shortened under certain conditions.
・During Cosmic Exploration, the standard synthesis, quick synthesis, and trial synthesis can be performed while a crafter's stellar mission is in progress.

*Updated Apr. 28, 2025 2:45 a.m. (PDT)
Among the above issues, the issue of the time between the issuance of a mech op directive and the start of the operation being shortened under certain conditions and the issue that standard synthesis, quick synthesis, and trial synthesis could be performed while a crafter's stellar mission was in progress were addressed by the maintenance of Apr. 28, 2025 1:30 a.m. to 1:38 a.m. (PDT).
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

*Updated Jul. 14, 2025 10:00 p.m. (PDT)
Among the above issues, the issue where the automatic aetherial reduction window may fail to close when the stellar mission objective is achieved during automatic aetherial reduction was addressed by the maintenance of May 26, 2025 5:00 p.m. to May 27, 2025 2:30 a.m. (PDT)
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

■Other frequently received inquiries
・During miner/botanist stellar missions, mineral deposits and quarries/mature trees and lush vegetation patches are not being displayed.

*Based on the details of the inquiries and received videos, it appears that the cause is likely due to the effects of “Prospect” and “Triangulate” expiring, which are used to make the mineral deposits and quarries/mature trees and lush vegetation patches visible.

We believe there is the possibility that when participating in mech ops and switching to the dedicated hotbar and repeatedly performing the mech ops specific actions may cause the “Prospect” and “Triangulate” actions to be mistakenly executed when switching back to the regular hotbar after the mech ops has ended, thereby disabling their effects.

We are continuing to investigate whether this issue is due to some other cause, but if mineral deposits and quarries/mature trees and lush vegetation patches are not being displayed, please check whether the “Prospect” and “Triangulate” effects are active. If they are inactive, please try executing the “Prospect” and “Triangulate” actions or switch to a different job and then switch back to miner/botanist as this will automatically activate these effects.

・During miner/botanist stellar missions, certain required items for the mission cannot be obtained.

*Based on the details of the inquiries, it appears that some players are unaware that after gathering, aetherial reduction is required to obtain the specified items for the stellar missions. We believe this is due to an issue with the display of the duty list which may have led to confusion. We will review addressing this in a future patch.

Aetherial reduction is currently required for the following stellar missions.

▽Miner
Class B Missions
- Stellar Repair Materials

Class A Missions
- A-2: Alchemical Refinement Materials
- A-3: Rare Material Extraction
- A-3: Fine-grade Water Filter Materials II
- A-3: Folkloric Materials I
- A-3: Folkloric Materials III

▽Botanist
Class B Missions
- Stellar Repair Materials

Class A Missions
- A-2: Alchemical Refinement Materials
- A-3: Rare Material Extraction
- A-3: Fine-grade Water Filter Materials II
- A-3: Folkloric Materials I
- A-3: Folkloric Materials III

We apologize for the inconvenience.

Known Issue Regarding the Designation of Cosmic Exploration's Star Contributor (May 1)
We have confirmed that the process related to the designation of Star Contributor is not operating properly in cosmic exploration and is currently in the following state:

・The Star Contributor for Apr. 29, 2025 is now in a state where no one has been designated. (Loporrit has been designated).
・As a result of the above, the Star Contributors from Apr. 25, 2025 to Apr. 29, 2025 have been shifted and treated as the Star Contributor from one day earlier. With this, the period of the designation has become 12 days.
・The Star Contributor for Apr. 23, 2025 is no longer recognized as the Star Contributor eight days later.

Upon investigation, it has been determined that the problem was caused by an issue in synchronizing multiple instances in the process of calculating the number of days elapsed since the release of cosmic exploration, resulting in a gap in calculation. This issue affects only the processing on May 1, 2025 2:00 a.m. (PDT), and the processing is expected to be normal thereafter.

Please note that it will be difficult for the system to correct the current data which has already been shifted, and we apologize for the inconvenience to all the Star Contributors from Apr. 23, 2025 to Apr. 29, 2025. Unfortunately, we will not be able to guarantee the original 14-day award period.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

title: News
body:
05/27/2025 5:00 AM
Known Issue Regarding the Designation of Cosmic Exploration's Star Contributor (May 27)
We have confirmed an issue that when Star Contributors are designated, during the few milliseconds when switching between the tallying period and the non-tallying period of the Starward Standings, if a character eligible for the Star Contributor performs an action that would add to their Starward Standings, the Starward Standings status of that character would become abnormal.

As a result of this abnormal status, it would be incorrectly determined that there were no characters who had accumulated contributions on the day of the Star Contributor designation process and Loporrit would be designated.

After investigating on all Worlds, we have confirmed that only one character was affected by this issue. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

We would like to inform you of the measures that have already been taken and will be taken moving forward regarding this issue.

■Timing for Addressing This Issue
The cause of this issue has already been identified, and we are currently working on addressing and verifying it.
We expect to complete verifications within a few days and once complete, will perform a brief Several Areas Emergency Maintenance for Sinus Ardorum on all Worlds.
We will make another announcement once the schedule for the emergency maintenance has been decided.

■Data Correction and Compensation for the Affected Character
The data of the affected character was corrected during the maintenance performed today.
At present, the data is being displayed on the Starward Standings Stela as if it had been designated on the relevant day May 23, and the customer can obtain the “Star Contributor” effect.

However, considering the shortened award period from the originally planned 14 days, we are compensating a certain number of Cosmocredits and Lunar Credits as an apology. A GM will notify the affected customer individually at a later date and we kindly ask for your patience.

Also, similar to the issue we announced the other day, we are considering measures such as distributing a special item that grants the "Star Contributor" status to users as compensation for the shortened award period. We are also considering additional special measures regarding the display on the Starward Standings Stela.
As each of these will require separate development times, we are planning to address them at a later date. We will keep you updated and thank you for your patience.

We sincerely apologize for the repeated inconvenience caused by this issue.

[Important]Regarding the End of Windows® 10 Support / System Requirements Update
FINAL FANTASY XIV support for Windows® 10 will end on October 14, 2025.

Microsoft will no longer provide security updates or support for PCs running Windows® 10 after October 14, 2025 so we have found that continuing support for this operating system is a difficult proposition.

You will likely be able to play FINAL FANTASY XIV on Windows® 10 systems even after the end of support. However, after we discontinue support, we will as a general rule no longer be able to provide support for problems arising as a result of the operating system.

Square Enix may respond to requests for technical support regarding Windows® 10 issues after the end of support, but such informal support will be limited, on a case-by-case basis, and is not guaranteed.

In addition, to accompany this change, the OS/CPU requirements for the Windows® version will be updated on October 14, 2025. Please see below for the updated requirements.
https://sqex.to/nBFlc

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

Compensation for issues related to the Designation of Cosmic Exploration's Star Contributor (Aug. 5)
Due to issues regarding awards for the Designation of Cosmic Exploration's Star Contributor, some customers did not receive the 14 days of awards they were supposed to receive. We will compensate them in Patch 7.3 and 7.31 as follows.

■Implementing in Patch 7.3
The following items will be sent via Moogle Delivery Service. Mog Letters will be delivered sequentially after the patch is released.

・When used in “Sinus Ardorum” or stars released in the future, you will receive 3 Adventurer's Parcel containing 10,000 Cosmocredits.
・When used in “Sinus Ardorum,” you will receive 2 Adventurer's Parcel containing 5,000 Lunar Credits.

■Implementing in Patch 7.31
Starting from the day of implementation of 7.31, characters' holograms will be displayed on the Starward Standings holograms in “Sinus Ardorum,” and their names will appear on the Starward Standings Stela for 14 days.
※It will be displayed in the World where you received the awards.

In addition, the following items will be sent via Moogle Delivery Service. Mog Letters will be delivered sequentially after the patch is released.

・When used on “Phaenna," which will be added in Patch 7.31, it will grant players the “Star Contributor" effect for 14 days.
※Using the item will apply the effect. Effects are displayed on Phaenna and remain active for 14 days (336 hours) regardless of login status.
※Players can receive the award for the Star Contributor even while this item is in effect. Doing so will not suspend or extend the remaining time of the effect, but please rest assured that players will not be excluded from receiving the award.
※If new stars are added to Cosmic Exploration in future updates, they will only be available on those new stars.

・2 “Adventurer's Parcel” containing currency that can be used in “Phaenna.”

body:
08/07/2025 8:08 AM
Known Issues Regarding Client Crash In Specific Conditions (Aug. 7)
We have confirmed issues where the client may crash under certain conditions. Upon investigation, please find below the details of multiple situations where this problem occurs along with temporary workarounds.

■Issue ①: Client may crash upon exiting a duty
We have confirmed that the client may crash when exiting a duty if more than 101 entries are registered in the blacklist.

We have received many reports that this occurs when exiting to housing areas.
However, it is not limited to housing areas and may occur in all areas depending on the content and volume of communication between the server and client when exiting from a duty.

This issue will be addressed with a HotFix on Friday, August 8th.

*Updated Aug. 8, 2025 3:15 a.m. (PDT)/ 10:15 (GMT)/ 11:15 (BST)/ 20:15 (AEST)
Issue ① was addressed by the maintenance of Aug. 7, 2025 11:00 p.m. to Aug. 8, 2025 1:30 a.m. (PDT)/ Aug. 8, 2025 6:00 to 8:30 (GMT)/ 7:00 to 9:30 (BST)/ 16:00 to 18:30 (AEST).
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

■Issue ②: Client may crash when receiving a chat
We have confirmed that the client may crash under certain conditions when the "Maximum Display Count" for chat bubbles is changed to a lower value in Chat Bubble Settings > General Settings > Basic Settings.

We have also confirmed that this issue can be avoided by either logging out and back in, or by disabling and then re-enabling chat bubbles after changing the "Maximum Display Count" to a lower value.
We kindly ask you to try one of the above methods to avoid the issue.

■Issue ③: The client may crash upon closing the tutorial window for transportation or escort quests
Under certain conditions upon closing the tutorial-specific explanation window for quests such as transportation and escort quests, we have confirmed that the client may force close.

This issue does not occur when the tutorial-specific explanation window opens automatically for the first time. It only happens when the window is opened and closed via the objective list or chat log link. Therefore, we kindly ask that you refrain from opening the tutorial-specific explanation window from the "?" icon displayed.

Additionally, we ask for your patience as it is expected to take time to address issues ② and ③.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

*Updated Sep. 2, 2025 3:55 a.m. (PDT)
Issues ② and ③ were addressed by the maintenance of Sep. 1, 2025 11:00 p.m. to Sep. 2, 2025 2:05 a.m. (PDT).
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

[Important]Important Notice about Software Tokens and Software Authenticators (Sep. 16)
This is a notice to all customers who use a Software Token or Software Authenticator.

If you are using a Software Token or Software Authenticator (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, etc.) on your smartphone and decide to switch to a new phone or delete the app, you will need to use an Emergency Removal Password to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator from the old device, after which you must re-register the app to your new device. If you are planning on switching phones or deleting the application, please be sure you have your Emergency Removal Password at hand first.

*In the case you cannot perform an emergency removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator, you will no longer be able to log in to or use the various services related to your applicable Square Enix account.
*New registrations for Software Tokens have closed as of November 21, 2023, so please use Software Authenticator Apps or Square Enix Security Tokens (Key Ring Type) after performing the Emergency Removal.

How to confirm your Emergency Removal Password

(1) Log in to the Square Enix Account Management System.

Square Enix Account Management System:
https://sqex.to/fHa

(2) After you have logged into the Square Enix Account Management System, your Emergency Removal Password will be displayed under “Token Usage Status” below the “Square Enix Account Information” section.

*The Emergency Removal Password is a one-time password that changes after each use. After you have used it, you must log into the Square Enix Account Management System again to obtain your new one-time Emergency Removal Password.

Before you switch phones or delete the application, please be sure to follow the above steps to confirm and store your Emergency Removal Password in a safe place. After you have switched phones or deleted your application, this password will be necessary to perform the Emergency Removal of the Software Token/Software Authenticator registered to your old device.

How to perform an emergency removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator

(1) Go to the Software Token/Software Authenticator Emergency Removal page and enter your Square Enix ID and password and your Emergency Removal Password.

Software Token Emergency Removal page:
https://sqex.to/GPE

(2) An email containing the Software Token/Software Authenticator removal URL will be sent to the email address registered to your Square Enix account.

(3) Click on the URL to remove your Software Token/Software Authenticator
* Note that the URL will expire after 60 minutes. Please be sure to click on it and complete the removal of your Software Token/Software Authenticator before it expires.

How to Re-register your Software Token/Software Authenticator

Please visit the links below for step-by-step instructions on re-registering your app and purchasing a Square Enix Security Token.
*New registrations for Software Tokens have closed as of November 21, 2023, so they may no longer be used after an Emergency Removal.
Please use Software Authenticator Apps or Square Enix Security Tokens (Key Ring Type).

[Software Authenticator] https://sqex.to/2HJDL
[Purchase Square Enix Security Tokens (Key Ring Type)] https://sqex.to/451zR

If you have lost your Emergency Removal Password or are unable to perform the emergency removal of the Software Token or Software Authenticator yourself, the Support Center will be able to remove it for you once account ownership is verified. Please review the FAQ below for further details.

How do I remove the Square Enix Security Token from my account?
https://sqex.to/mVZ

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the steps described in this announcement, please contact the Square Enix Support Center.

Square Enix Support Center
https://sqex.to/s5G9O

10/14/2025 6:21 PM
[Important]Purchasing Genuine FINAL FANTASY XIV Game Codes
We have been monitoring an increase in the redemption of FINAL FANTASY XIV game codes which were obtained fraudulently. These game codes include registration codes for the Windows/Mac version of the Starter Edition, Complete Edition, and the Dawntrail expansion.

Many of these game codes have been illegally obtained from official retailers, typically using stolen credit cards or other compromised data, and are then sold at a discount on third-party sites. Until now, when we determined that a game code was obtained fraudulently we would invalidate it before it could be used. However, if the game code was already redeemed, we would give the benefit of the doubt that the user did not know it was fraudulently obtained and would not penalize the account.

While the fraudulent transaction may not have been made by the person who redeemed the game code, purchasing game codes from unlicensed sites supports and perpetuates these illegal activities. To reduce these illegal transactions, we will begin suspending accounts that have redeemed fraudulently obtained FINAL FANTASY XIV game codes.

If you believe your account has been suspended due to the redemption of a FINAL FANTASY XIV game code, please contact the Support Center (https://sqex.to/FFXIVsupport) to regain access to the account. As part of regaining account access, the redeemer of the fraudulently obtained game code will need to pay Square Enix the retail value of the game code as well as the outstanding retail values of any additional fraudulent redemptions or purchases.

To ensure that you purchase legitimate FINAL FANTASY XIV game codes, we recommend only buying from your local game retailer or official online retailers.

Retailers selling FINAL FANTASY XIV Game Codes for American FFXIV accounts:
- Square Enix Store (Americas)
- GameStop
- Green Man Gaming
- Humble Bundle
- Newegg
- Steam

Retailers selling FINAL FANTASY XIV Game Codes for European FFXIV accounts:
- Square Enix Store (Europe)
- Green Man Gaming
- Humble Bundle
- Steam

We appreciate your assistance and understanding as we work to counter fraudulent activities.

Known Issues Following the Release of Patch 7.4 (Dec. 18)
We have identified the issues listed below.
The issues are being investigated and addressed, and additional information will follow as the situation develops.

[Current Known Issues]

-During a Group Pose, the client may freeze when taking a photo in portrait mode under specific conditions. (Windows®/ Mac version only)

Upon investigation, this issue may occur when taking a photo in portrait mode without having “Remove Aspect Ratio Limits” checked on while the system configuration resolution is set to a widescreen format wider than 16:9. When taking a photo under these circumstances, the system adjusts the screen to a 16:9 aspect ratio. However, during this process, the client may freeze depending on the user's computer specs.

If you are playing the game under certain conditions, having “Remove Aspect Ratio Limits” checked on will allow you to record in vertical mode without the client freezing. However, please note that removing the aspect ratio limit means the recording will occur at your current resolution rather than being adjusted to a 16:9 aspect ratio. We would appreciate it if you could test this within the scope of what is possible.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused and we thank you for your patience until the issue is resolved.

*Updated Dec. 25, 2025 1:35 a.m. (PST)
This issue was addressed by the maintenance of Dec. 24, 2025 8:00 p.m. to Dec. 25, 2025 12:50 a.m. (PST).
