body:
12/25/2025 3:00 AM
[Follow-up]Automatic Disbandment of CWLS/PvP Teams/Fellowships in NA Data Center Worlds (Dec. 19): Follow-up
We would like to provide an update regarding the situation in which some Cross-world Linkshells (CWLS), PvP Teams, and Fellowships in the North American Data Center were forcibly disbanded.

■Issue Details
Following a detailed investigation, we confirmed that during maintenance on Dec. 16, 2025, a problem occurred with the Lobby database server. Due to this issue, some CWLS / PvP Teams / Fellowships on the North American Data Center were mistakenly recognized as having no members present, which triggered the automatic disband process, resulting in this behavior.

Please note that the occurrence was limited to the timeframe during maintenance—from when the issue began until it was resolved. No issues have occurred after maintenance reopened.
-------------------------------------
■Actions Taken for Cross-world Linkshells (CWLS)
We have restored the CWLS that were disbanded during the emergency maintenance performed on Dec. 24, 2025.

▼Cases where the maximum number of CWLS has been exceeded due to recovery
If the recovery process has caused you to exceed the maximum number of 8 CWLS you can join, any CWLS exceeding this limit will be in a state where you are still joined but they will not appear on your list and also unable to chat. If you are exceeding the maximum amount, a message will appear upon login with this information.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, but please kindly leave any unnecessary CWLS so your count is below the maximum amount.

Additionally, the listing of your CWLS will have to be reorganized to your preference. After you leave any unnecessary CWLS, please reset the sorting order from the gear icon in the CWLS window.

▼Cases where CWLS with identical names were created due to recovery
We have confirmed a number of cases where, after a CWLS was automatically disbanded, another CWLS was created with the same name.

Since CWLS with identical names cannot exist within the same logical data center, we have added a "#" to the end of the newly created CWLS names. Had this issue not caused automatic disbandment to occur, it would have been impossible to create a new CWLS with the same name; therefore, we have determined that the original CWLS that was forcibly dissolved retains the right to use that name.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, but if a "#" has been added to your CWLS name, please change to any other desired name via the Cross-world Linkshell submenu.

-------------------------------------
■Regarding fellowships
A detailed investigation confirmed that in addition to the automatic disbandment, there were cases where players were forced to leave a fellowship without it being disbanded.

During the emergency maintenance performed on Dec. 24, 2025, we implemented the following fixes for the disbandment and cases where players were forced to leave their fellowship.

▼Addressing automatically disbanded fellowships
We have restored the forcibly disbanded fellowships.

▼Addressing cases where players were forced to leave said fellowship
We have added characters back to their fellowships to the extent possible. However, restoration was difficult due to data issues in the following cases.

・Cases where the affected fellowship had reached its maximum member capacity of 1,000 members
・Cases where players frequently left and joined the affected fellowship making restoration impossible due to data issues

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and kindly ask for your understanding.

▼Cases where restoration caused the maximum number of joined fellowships to be exceeded
If the restoration causes you to exceed the maximum number of 10 fellowships, any fellowships exceeding this limit will be in a state where you are still joined but they will not appear on your list. If you are exceeding the maximum amount, a message will appear upon login with this information.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, but please kindly leave any unnecessary fellowships to adjust your count to below the maximum amount.

-------------------------------------
■Addressing PvP teams
As players can only join a single PvP team, and due to the complexity of resolving the issue, we are continuing to carefully verify the data.
We sincerely apologize for the delay and will send an update once the timing of the fix has been determined. We greatly appreciate your patience until this issue is resolved.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

02/05/2026 2:15 AM
[Follow-up]Automatic Disbandment of CWLS/PvP Teams/Fellowships in NA Data Center Worlds (Dec. 19): Follow-up 2
Regarding the issue with the lobby database server which occurred during maintenance on Tuesday, December 16, 2025 and caused some Cross-world Linkshells / PvP teams / Fellowships on the NA data centers to be automatically disbanded, below are the measures which were implemented during the all Worlds maintenance on Wednesday, February 4, 2026 where HotFixes for Patch 7.41 were applied.

■ Addressing CWLS

▼ Regarding the situation where masters were automatically transferred
It was discovered that among certain CWLS that were not automatically disbanded during the maintenance on December 16, 2025, some were mistakenly recognized as having no master, resulting in them being automatically transferred.

Regarding this matter, except in cases where the relevant character has withdrawn from the relevant CWLS, we have restored the master to the character who held it as of the maintenance on December 16, 2025. For characters who became a master due to the effects of this issue, we have changed their rank to the rank (Leader or Member) as of the maintenance on December 16, 2025.

Among the affected CWLS, there were some changes such as the master being manually transferred to another character after they were automatically transferred due to the issue. However, we have uniformly reverted them to their previous state as it was difficult from the logs to determine whether the original master’s intent was involved.

Please perform master transfers and other actions as necessary. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

▼ Regarding the restoration performed on Thursday, Dec. 25, 2025 for CWLS that had been disbanded
During the emergency maintenance carried out on Thursday, Dec. 25, 2025, we performed restoration for CWLS that had been disbanded. However, it was discovered that characters who had previously withdrawn and should not have been restored were also restored during this procedure. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by this.

Accordingly, we have carried out measures to once again remove those characters who had previously withdrawn.

■ Addressing PvP teams
Upon detailed investigation, in addition to teams being forcibly disbanded, we discovered cases where team members were forcibly removed as well as cases where leadership was automatically transferred.

We have implemented restoration measures to revert these back to the state they were in when the issue occurred. However, if team leaders or members have already joined other PvP teams, restoration through the system is not possible. We apologize for the inconvenience and kindly ask that you reform your team as necessary.

With these measures, all data restoration work related to the impact of this issue has been completed.
Once again, we apologize for the extended period of inconvenience.

Regarding the Delivery of Fan Festival 2026 Commemorative Items
We are expecting some delays in the delivery of in-game items for bonus item codes and optional item purchases after FINAL FANTASY XIV Fan Festival 2026 items are made available for purchase at the Online Store.
Please take the following into consideration before purchasing any optional items.

Please make sure you have enough free space to receive items before making a purchase by taking items from any letters you have received in the "Purchases & Rewards" tab and deleting the letters afterwards.
*Please note that if you have purchased multiple items, they will be sent to you in separate letters. Please make sure that you have freed up enough space.

You can only receive a total of 20 Mog Letters related to bonus items, optional items, or gift items. If you do not have enough free space, the system will attempt to redeliver the items at another time. The time taken between each attempt to redeliver optional items may be extended in order to reduce the server load this process has on the general delivery system.

*Delivery timing of optional items
The delivery time of optional items varies depending on the type of purchase.

・Items purchased for single characters
→ Items will be delivered immediately after purchase
・Account-wide item purchases
→ Log in with a character after purchase to have the item delivered to that character

With account-wide item purchases, you must log in with the character after making the purchase in order to receive the item. Please be sure to log out and then log back in again if the purchase was made whilst logged in to FINAL FANTASY XIV.
Please note that if you purchased both types of optional items, the items may be delivered at different times due to the nature of the delivery system.

You can check the status on the Online Store via "Your Account" → "Purchase History".

Please note item deliveries may be delayed during peak times. If you have still not received your items despite confirming all of the above points, please be advised that it can take up to 24 hours before items are delivered. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and thank you for your understanding.

title: News
body:
05/12/2026 3:45 AM
Issue with Furnishings Not Displaying Properly in Housing (May 12)
We would like to provide an update regarding the previously announced issue where furnishings may not be displayed properly in housing.

This issue can be broadly divided into the two cases below, and we would like to explain each in turn.

■ Case 1: When the number of furnishings on screen exceeds 400, but the checks that determine what should be hidden are not performed correctly.
Our investigation to date has confirmed issues with the following processes:

・In certain cases, when furnishings placed on different floors enter the camera view, the process that determines the positions of all furnishings on screen may fail.
・When switching furnishings between visible/hidden states, unintended fade processing is occurring.
・For furnishings with light sources, there are cases where the light reaches the camera view but the furnishing itself is off-screen, and the checks are not performed correctly—resulting in the light-source furnishing being hidden.

When these three issues overlap, we have confirmed that furnishings may become hidden at unintended times depending on furnishing placement, camera angle, and direction in which the camera is moved. For this case, we have already identified the cause and are currently working on a fix.

■ Case 2: When furnishings become hidden even though the number of furnishings on screen does not exceed 400.
Regarding this case, we have received numerous reports stating that it occurs even though fewer than 400 furnishings have been placed to begin with.

In addition to verification across a variety of environments (PC specifications and platforms), we have also investigated through a wide range of methods such as copying the housing data of affected players into our development environment. However, we have not been able to reproduce the issue even once in the development environment so far, and identifying the cause has proven difficult.

Based on our analysis of the program, it is unlikely that the display limit processing would trigger when fewer than 400 furnishings are present. As such, we have formed the hypothesis that, under certain conditions, information for furnishings that were previously rendered on screen may continue to remain in the client’s memory, and that this may be added to the current on-screen count. However, currently we do not have enough information to confirm this, and we have not yet been able to establish a clear direction for a fix.

To help us solve the issue, if you encounter the symptoms described in this case, we would greatly appreciate it if you could submit a detailed report in the official forum thread below, using the provided template. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your cooperation.

[Official Forum Thread]
https://forum.square-enix.com/ffxiv/threads/528470

[Template]
=========================================
・Date & time occurred:

・Platform:

・If playing on PC, please include your PC specifications (System Information):

・World name:

・Character name:

・Housing information (residential district / ward / plot):

・Number of furnishings placed:

・Number of hired NPCs / mannequins placed:

・Number of furnishings with light sources placed:

・Number of times you entered/left the house from client launch until the issue occurred:

・Actions immediately before the issue occurred (placing/removing furnishings, camera movement, etc.):

・Item name(s) of the furnishing(s) affected:

・Number of characters inside the house when the issue occurred:

・If other characters were present, did they observe the same issue as well? :

・After the issue occurred, does it persist even if you leave the house once and re-enter? :

・After the issue occurred, does it persist even if you restart the client and enter the house immediately after logging in? :

・If the issue was resolved by any action other than leaving/re-entering the house or restarting the client, please let us know:

- In Dancing Mad (Ultimate), when the boss uses Trine, the direction of the yellow triangular attack indicator that appears in the northwest is incorrect.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience these issues may be causing.
